jobs.title: Application Support Analyst (Junior)
jobs.description:
Application Support Analyst (Junior)  

Missions  

RESPONSIBILITIES  

Provide first and second level support for Financing \& Transaction Banking (FTB) business applications, ensuring high availability and operational stability.  

Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents and user issues within agreed service levels.  

Act as the primary liaison between business users, development teams, and infrastructure teams to ensure effective issue resolution and communication.  

Monitor application performance, identify recurring issues, and drive continuous service improvements.  

Support application releases, change management activities, and production deployments.  

Maintain support documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.  

Ensure compliance with operational controls, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.  

Support users across multiple regions and time zones.  

Profile  

REQUIREMENTS  

Mandatory  

Experience providing first and second level application support in a production environment.  

Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.  

Experience investigating and resolving functional and technical application issues.  

Ability to coordinate effectively with business users, development teams, and infrastructure teams.  

Experience supporting application releases, production deployments, and change management activities.  

Knowledge of application monitoring and performance management.  

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

Ability to work in a fast paced environment supporting business critical applications.  

English required.  

Nice to Have  

Experience supporting Financing \& Transaction Banking (FTB) applications.  

Knowledge of IT service management best practices.  

ITIL certification.  

Nice to Have  

Project experience with Microsoft Azure.  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.  

LANGUAGE:  

Ability to communicate in English, both orally and in writing, is a requirement as the person in this position will need to collaborate regularly with colleagues and partners in the United States.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  

  

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal\-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

 **Your role and responsibilities**  

  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute service work as per work instructions and in accordance with ABB quality and safety guidelines. Each day, you will deliver quality customer service planning and execute service work as per customer order and expectation. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring customer retention by effectively communicating service work timeline and expectations.  

  

The work model for the role is: \#LI\-onsite. (traveling role field service: 50% on surface, 50% underground)  

  

This role is contributing to the **Automation Process Industries, Mining and Materials in Sudbury, Ontario.**  

  

You will be mainly accountable for:

  

* Execute field service work safely, efficiently, and in accordance with customer requirements, quality standards, and agreed timelines.
* Provide an outstanding customer experience through clear communication, responsiveness, and a strong sense of urgency.
* Deliver an exceptional customer experience by communicating clearly, demonstrating urgency, and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer operations, eliminate pain points, and communicate service growth opportunities to ABB account teams.
* Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues through remote and on\-site support for certified products and service offerings.
* Plan and prepare service activities by securing the required materials, parts, tools, and equipment to achieve a first\-time\-right outcome.
* Drive continuous improvement by recommending corrective and preventive actions, improving work processes, and preparing accurate service documentation and customer reports.
* Promote ABB's safety culture while collaborating with customers and colleagues, reporting hazards, mentoring junior technicians and engineers, providing technical guidance, and delivering training when required.

 **Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.  

  

**Qualifications for the role**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Hands\-on experience servicing, maintaining, commissioning, and repairing medium\-voltage (MV) equipment and other industrial systems.
* Strong technical knowledge of industrial automation, software applications, and control systems; experience with ABB MV/LV Drives, PLCs, and DCS systems is considered an asset.
* Demonstrated mechanical aptitude, problem\-solving skills, and ability to support complex industrial equipment in field environments.

Excellent English communication skills, with a valid driver’s license and passport, and willingness to travel extensively to customer sites (60\-70%). French is a strong asset.  
* 

**What’s in it for you?**


We give you the space to lead, the support to grow, and the chance to make a difference. Whether you're solving problems, building something new, or helping others succeed, your impact is real. You’ll be part of a team that values your voice and celebrates your progress.

 **More About us**


ABB's Mining \& Material team delivers solutions and services ensuring our customers get the most out of their investment. Our Mining \& Material solutions help improve safety and productivity of the mines while reducing maintenance and energy costs. Deep domain knowledge enables us to truly understand and address our customers’ challenges and opportunities.  

  

Our Mining \& Material Service Team supports customers on ABB systems and solutions throughout North America. Our customers operate 24x7 and rely on ABB to support from installation and initial start\-up, through to life\-cycle services to maximize the availability of the solutions provided by ABB and optimize their operations.

 **Benefits**: Our benefits? Competitive, comprehensive, and crafted with you in mind.

  

While base salary is determined by things such as the successful applicant’s qualifications and experience, this position is expected to pay between $67,500 and $99,000 annually and is bonus eligible.

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

**How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 180 years?**

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast\-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like Industrial Quality \& Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 46,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!  



**Location:** This is a remote position and candidates are preferred to be located in the **Quebec City area.**

**What’s the role?**

The Field Service Technician, Level I is an entry\-level technical position responsible for developing the knowledge and skills required to install, maintain, troubleshoot, calibrate, and repair Coordinate Measuring Machines and related metrology equipment.  



Working under the guidance of senior technicians, the Field Service Technician completes formal and on\-the\-job training while supporting service activities at customer locations across Canada. The position contributes to equipment reliability, customer satisfaction, and the timely and accurate completion of service documentation.  



**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**

**Technical Training and Development**

* Complete required classroom, online, and on\-the\-job technical training.
* Develop proficiency in the installation, preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repair of Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMMs) and related metrology equipment.
* Build knowledge of mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, and computer\-controlled systems.
* Develop the ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, equipment manuals, and service documentation.
* Demonstrate continued progress toward the technical competencies and certifications required for the position.

**Field Service Support**

* Assist senior technicians with equipment installations, customer service calls, preventive maintenance, calibrations, troubleshooting, and repairs.
* Perform assigned service activities under appropriate supervision and within the authorized scope of training.
* Following completion of required training, independently complete assigned service activities in accordance with company procedures.
* Diagnose basic mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, and system\-related issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior technicians or the appropriate technical support resource.
* Inspect equipment, identify service requirements, and recommend appropriate follow\-up actions.
* Use company\-approved tools, diagnostic equipment, and service procedures safely and effectively.

**Customer Service**

* Provide professional, responsive, and solutions\-focused support to customers.
* Communicate service findings, equipment status, completed work, and required follow\-up actions clearly and accurately.
* Manage customer expectations by providing timely updates regarding service progress and next steps.
* Represent the company professionally at customer locations and during all customer interactions.
* Develop effective working relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support the timely resolution of customer concerns by coordinating with the appropriate internal teams.

**Documentation and Administration**

* Complete service reports, work orders, calibration records, expense reports, and other required records accurately and on time.
* Document equipment conditions, work performed, parts used, outstanding concerns, and recommended follow\-up actions.
* Maintain accurate records in applicable company systems.
* Submit expenses and supporting documentation in accordance with company policies and established timelines.
* Protect confidential customer and company information.

**Tools, Parts, and Inventory**

* Maintain assigned tools, diagnostic equipment, spare parts, and consumables in good working condition.
* Manage assigned spare\-parts and consumables inventory in accordance with company procedures and budget guidelines.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and report missing, damaged, or required replacement items.
* Ensure tools, parts, and equipment are properly stored and secured.
* Coordinate with service, deployment, receiving, and warehouse teams as required to support customer and operational needs.

**Safety and Compliance**

* Follow company health and safety requirements, quality standards, security protocols, and service procedures.
* Comply with customer\-site safety requirements and use required personal protective equipment.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.
* Identify and report safety hazards, damaged equipment, and unsafe working conditions.
* Operate company vehicles and material\-handling equipment safely and in accordance with applicable policies.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Do you qualify?**

* Fluency in both English and French, written and spoken, is required.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
### **About PixMob**


PixMob creates magical experiences for live events around the world ✨. You might have seen 60,000 fans light up at the Super Bowl or at a Coldplay concert. Our mission? To spark joy and unforgettable memories for every fan.


We work with international artists, event organizers, sports teams, and brands to make every event extra special. At PixMob, innovation and design are in our DNA. From rapid prototyping to mass manufacturing, we craft cutting\-edge wireless tech right at our Montreal HQ. And we care about the planet —we fight single\-use plastics and use recycled or compostable materials wherever we can.

**We’re looking for an IT Support Technician**

### **About the role**


We're looking for an IT Support Technician to join our team in Montreal. You'll be the first person our colleagues turn to when something isn't working, whether they're sitting next to you in the office or working remotely. The role is hands\-on: fixing problems, setting up laptops, keeping our inventory straight and making sure meeting rooms just work.


This is an entry\-level position. If you've recently finished a DEC, DEP or AEC in IT support and have some real\-world experience from an internship, a previous job or serious school projects, we'd like to hear from you. You'll learn a lot, and you'll have room to grow into more technical work over time.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* Handle first\-line support requests coming in through Jira, chat or people walking up to your desk
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues on **macOS** (about 90% of our fleet) and Windows (about 10%), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar) and everyday business apps
* Prepare, deploy and manage laptops through our MDM tools (Mosyle for Macs, NinjaOne for Windows)
* Run onboarding and offboarding: create and disable accounts, set up equipment, make sure new hires are ready on day one
* Keep the hardware inventory and asset tracking up to date (laptops, monitors, peripherals, accessories)
* Look after meeting rooms and AV equipment: screens, video conferencing, cabling, and quick fixes when a meeting is about to start
* Keep the office IT setup in good shape: desks, docking stations, monitors, cable management, and setting up or moving workstations when people join or change seats
* Document fixes and write short how\-to guides so people can help themselves
* Escalate to senior team members when needed, with clear notes on what you've already tried
* Basic network and printer troubleshooting

### **What we’re looking for**

* DEC, DEP or AEC in IT support, computer science or a related field
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience, internships and school projects count
* Comfortable supporting macOS users and Google Workspace; some Windows experience is a plus
* Bilingual, French and English, spoken and written (you'll support people in both languages every day)
* Good at explaining technical things to non\-technical people, patient, and calm when several requests land at once
* Organized, reliable, and able to keep track of tickets and inventory without being chased
* Able to be in the office regularly for walk\-in support and hardware work

**Nice to have**

* Experience with a ticketing system (Jira Service Management or similar)
* Familiarity with an MDM or RMM tool (Mosyle, NinjaOne, Jamf, Kandji)
* Exposure to Linux
* Basic networking knowledge (Wi\-Fi, DHCP, VPN)
* Experience with AV or video conferencing setups (Google Meet hardware, Zoom Rooms)

### **Languages \& Inclusivity**


You’ll need to be fluent in English (written \& spoken), as day\-to\-day work involves collaboration with international employees — US, Europe, Asia\-Pacific, and more.


Inclusivity is at the heart of our culture . We welcome and value candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our job posting uses simplified grammar to make it easier to read across languages and is not intended to exclude or favor any gender.


Join us to help build a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected and empowered ✨.

*Thanks for your interest in PixMob and this role! Only selected candidates will be contacted.*

jobs.title: I.T. Support Technician
jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF\-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

  



We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000\+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

  



Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

  



Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

  



Join our team!

  


**I.T. Support Technician**



We are looking for a hands\-on I.T. Support Technician to provide onsite IT support for a location of approximately 120 users. This role will focus on supporting end\-user technology, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, collaboration tools, business applications, and day\-to\-day technical issues. The successful candidate will be customer\-focused, organized, and able to resolve issues efficiently while collaborating with the broader IT team when escalation is required.

  



Specific Responsibilities


* Provide onsite deskside support for approximately 120 users, ensuring a high level of customer service and timely resolution of technical issues.
* Support end\-user technology, including laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, mobile devices, printers, meeting room equipment, and collaboration tools.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network connectivity, Microsoft 365, VPN, printing, and business application issues.
* Install, configure, deploy, and replace IT equipment in accordance with company standards and asset lifecycle processes.
* Manage incidents and service requests through the ticketing system, ensuring accurate documentation, prioritization, follow\-up, and closure.
* Escalate complex issues to the appropriate IT teams or external partners while maintaining ownership of the user experience.
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, including workstation setup, account access coordination, equipment preparation, and user orientation.
* Maintain local IT inventory, track assigned assets, and coordinate equipment repairs, replacements, and returns as required.
* Create and maintain clear documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures to support consistent IT operations.
* Adhere to established IT policies, procedures, cybersecurity requirements, and service standards.

  



Position Requirements


* Technical diploma in Computer Systems, Information Technology, or equivalent experience preferred.
* Minimum of 4 to 6 years of experience in a deskside, service desk, field support, or IT support role.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for Windows workstations, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, printers, peripheral equipment, and common business applications.
* Experience supporting end users in an onsite environment with a strong focus on customer service and professionalism.
* Ability to prioritize incidents and service requests based on urgency, impact, and business needs.
* Responsible, autonomous, accountable, and able to work independently while collaborating with remote IT teams as needed.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, time\-management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and remain effective during urgent support situations.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar incident/request management tool preferred.
* A\+ certification, ITIL Foundation certification, or other relevant IT certifications considered an asset.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
* Availability to participate in after\-hours or on\-call support rotation, if required.
* Ability to travel as needed.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:**



Position requires Level II Clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program.

  


**By joining Top Aces, you will find:**


* A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
* Opportunities for development and growth;
* Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
* A flexible schedule;
* Attractive benefit plan.

  



Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**



At Top Aces, all employees are welcome regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability or age. The masculine form may be used in this job description solely for ease of reading but refers to men, women and gender diversity.

jobs.title: Bilingual IT Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


The Bilingual IT Service Specialist, will work with a team in the Technical Helpdesk to provide first\-level technical support for Carquest Stores, Corporate and Distribution Center team members. Exploris and Weblink end users, applications and infrastructure; and perform technical support to keep all systems performing with minimum down time. The IT Service Specialist will work with internal and external customers to gather and verify information to accurately diagnose IT issues and troubleshoot to complete resolution.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Under general supervision, troubleshoot IT issues (identify probable cause with hard facts and data, investigate resolution, determine root cause, and demonstrate success of solution), by following instructions, learning from senior Analysts and Developers, and collaborating with other support teams.
* Escalate more complex problems to next level.
* Utilize software release documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQs to aid in problem resolution.
* Respond with urgency to system failure situations and provide collaborative solutions to other analysts, developers, engineers, and support teams.
* Clearly document problem resolution thoroughly in support tools for future reference and team member training.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bilingual English/French
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Experience using Microsoft Office Professional Series (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint and Outlook)
* Experience using incident management systems (such as Service Now), for incident, problem, and change management processes
* Previous experience in Exploris /Weblink and Basic understanding of retail operational procedures preferred
* Ability to troubleshoot IT issues as well as hardware issues for the equipment in the stores Understanding of accounts receivable and inventory management preferred but not required
* Ability to integrate with a team, yet work independently to resolve technical problems
* Experience handling multiple assignments and using prioritization skills in high\-demand situations
* Ability to communicate effectively with business users, technical staff and team members to reach solutions collaboratively, including the ability to present information and respond to questions from developers, engineers and customers
* Ability to respond to off\-hour emergencies and perform evening, weekend, and holiday work as necessary
* Ability to work on weekends one weekend a month as well as on call during the evenings every other month.

 **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**


1\-3 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience

 **CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**


ITIL certifications preferred

 **PHYSICAL DEMANDS**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; sit; talk or hear; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

 **WORK ENVIRONMENT**


The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Weekend and shift work will be required. Work Environment consists of normal office conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

  

Compensation Range: The range of expected compensation for this role is between 54,600\.00 CAD and 69,600\.00 CAD salary for a new team member. The rate offered to a successful candidate depends on multiple factors, including geographic location, experience in retail, automotive knowledge, education, leadership roles, and other skillsets ideal for this position and shift differential (if applicable).

* Opportunity to work for one of the largest after\-market auto parts provider in North America
* Visibility to career growth opportunities across the entire Advance Auto Parts organization
* Unlock earning potential with monthly or annual performance bonuses—eligibility varies by role.
* Access to a robust online training system for personal or leadership development
* A rewarding organizational culture through our team member recognition program

* Employee discounts
* Financial benefits including group RRSP with employer contribution and discounted stock purchase plans for all permanent team members

jobs.description:
The work mode arrangement for the position is full\-time on site.

  

The incumbent is responsible for effectively managing the caisse's computer equipment, IT systems and technological equipment. He or she also provides technological support to users. More specifically, you will be required to:

  

* Perform MIC platform administration activities (e.g. server shutdown and start\-up, verifying automatic system operations, managing access groups, performing maintenance on the back\-up unit and recovering files)

* Competitive salary and annual bonus
* 4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year

* Group insurance including telemedicine
* Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment

Help Desk Agent
jobs.description:
**About Us:**


Sonepar Canada is an independent family\-owned company with global market leadership in the business\-to\-business distribution of electrical, industrial and safety products and related solutions. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 100\+ locations with coverage in 9 provinces.


We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately\-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees.


To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com


***What’s In It For You?***


* You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
* You will be working for the world's \#1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
* A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
* We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
* An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.

**Position Scope:**


Sonepar IT Help Desk associates provide quality IT support via phone, email, virtual meeting, and after\-hours mobile phone. The position is 80% in the office from Monday to Friday with 1 day of working from except for 1 week per month at 100% working from the office. The service includes but is not limited to: taking initial requests by phone or email, troubleshooting, and managing hardware, software, internal ERP/WMS, or relatively simple network issues. All help desk associates need excellent problem\-solving, communication and interpersonal skills, as well as patience, a friendly attitude and the ability to work in a team environment. In addition, the help desk associate must have a solid technical understanding of the technology, including the various supported hardware, software, and network systems.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* General Support and Tasks: Sonepar IT Helpdesk Agent is responsible for providing software/technical support and assistance. They interact with customers over the phone or in person to resolve computer issues related to software and hardware issues.
* Troubleshoot customer issues: IT help desk agents also resolve issues that customers encounter on technical solutions used by the company that require guidance. They provide reliable and quality customer service to the caller associate.
* Ticket documentation: The IT help desk must thoroughly document the real\-time actions taken to execute service/incident related tickets with a high level of detail and clarity.
* Documentation: The IT Help Desk Agent must thoroughly document/update existing procedures related to the support area covered by the Sonepar Help Desk team.
* After Hours Support: Sonepar Support operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a week. After\-hours support is provided by a help desk agent on a rotational basis, approximately every six weeks. The after\-hours support assignment is weekly, from Monday evenings at 6:00 p.m. EST to Monday mornings at 6:30 a.m. EST. Support outside office hours is carried out remotely (from home), the necessary equipment is provided (laptop, cellular, headset). One bonus is offered per week of assistance outside office hours.

**Requirements:**


* 1\-3\+ years of experience in information technology with service and support computer hardware and software.
* Experience in customer service (phone/email support and communication).
* Bilingual, spoken and written (French/English).
* Experience in IT support.
* Knowledge of the Windows 11 environment.
* Knowledge of the Office 365 suite, teams, Acrobat Reader etc.
* Knowledge of IOS, Android, MacOS devices.
* Basic Active Directory Knowledge.
* Knowledge / experience with the use of the ticketing system, Service\-Now is a plus.
* Knowledge/experience with SX ERP and TWL WMS is a plus.
* May be available for office shifts from 6:30am to 3:30pm and 9:00am to 6:00pm. (Rotation)
* Ready to make a rotation support outside of working hours.

**Benefits \& Perks**


* We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits, including:
* Flexible benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account \& RRSP matching.
* Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
* Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soneparcanada/


Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id\=100057133913041


Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/SoneparCanada

**RESPONSABILITÉS CLÉS**


Soutien technique et dépannage

* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes matériels, dont sur les ordinateurs de bureau, les ordinateurs portables, les imprimantes et les périphériques
* Dépanner les problèmes logiciels dans l’environnement Windows, y compris les problèmes au niveau du système d’exploitation, les erreurs d’application et les configurations
* Aider en cas de problèmes de connectivité réseau (Wi\-Fi, VPN, LAN)
* Effectuer des tâches de base sur Active Directory : réinitialisation de mots de passe, déblocage de comptes, création de comptes utilisateurs
* Apporter son aide lors des processus d’accueil et de départ, y compris la mise en service et la mise hors service de l’équipement

**Ticket et documentation**

* Enregistrer, suivre et gérer toutes les demandes d'assistance et tous les incidents dans le système de gestion des tickets (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management ou équivalent)
* Documenter avec précision les étapes de dépannage, les solutions apportées et les problèmes récurrents
* Transmettre les problèmes non résolus ou complexes au soutien de niveau 2/niveau 3 en joignant une documentation complète
* Contribuer à l'enrichissement et à la mise à jour de la base de connaissances interne

**Service à la clientèle et communication**

* Apporter une assistance courtoise, claire et professionnelle aux utilisateurs finaux, que ce soit en personne, par téléphone ou courriel ou à l’aide d’outils de soutien à distance
* Définir et gérer les attentes des utilisateurs concernant les délais de résolution
* Assurer le suivi des tickets en cours afin de garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs et leur clôture dans les délais opportuns
* Être un interlocuteur calme et fiable en cas de perturbations techniques

**EXIGENCES**

**Formation et expérience**

* Diplôme du secondaire ou diplôme de formation général requis ; baccalauréat en ti, EN informatique ou dans un domaine connexe (nous faisons preuve de souplesse à ce sujet : la personne peut également posséder des certifications informatiques et son expérience sera prise en compte).
* Un ou deux ans d'expérience dans un service d'aide, de soutien informatique ou technique
* Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pratique sera prise en considération

**Habiletés techniques**

* Maîtrise du dépannage dans les environnements Windows 10/11 ; une expérience avec macOS serait un atout
* Expérience pratique des plateformes de gestion des tickets (ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk ou l’équivalent)
* Bonne connaissance de Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Connaissances de base des concepts réseau : DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN
* Expérience avec les outils d’aide à distance (p. ex., TeamViewer, AnyDesk, Remote Desktop)

**Compétences relationnelles**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite
* Capacité à expliquer clairement des concepts techniques à des néophytes
* Excellente gestion du temps et capacité à hiérarchiser plusieurs tickets en cours
* Patient, empathique et professionnel, même sous pression
* Motivation personnelle et envie d'apprendre et d'évoluer dans le domaine des TI

**Souhaitable / représente un plus**

* Certification CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+ ou ITIL Foundation
* Bilingue (français et anglais) un avantage pour un poste à Montréal
* Expérience dans un environnement de TI corporatif ou d’entreprise

**Notre offre**

* Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où les meilleures personnes souhaitent travailler, où elles peuvent transformer leur passion en carrière et réaliser pleinement leur potentiel.
* Développement individuel, formation en cours d’emploi et programmes conçus pour soutenir la progression de carrière.

* Trois semaines de vacances dès l’entrée en poste.

* Bonification du congé de maternité et de paternité.

jobs.title: Service Desk Technician L1
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  

  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------



We're seeking a Help Desk Technician to join our skilled IT Help Desk Operations team, providing support to local and global internal users. The goal is to deliver excellent technical and non\-technical support with outstanding customer service and timeliness. The role involves supporting both Mac and PC environments, resolving complex technical issues efficiently, and valuing the people behind the problems. This position operates Monday through Friday during standard business hours.  

  

* Provide hardware and software IT support and technical education to end users, both remotely and onsite.
* Apply critical thinking to efficiently troubleshoot simple and complex user requests and issues, providing context and information for the best solutions.
* Troubleshoot client\-side network connectivity issues, including digital authentication, remote access, secure Wi\-Fi, wired connectivity to the internal network, password resets, etc.
* Support user requests, perform break/fix or remote installations as needed.
* Support AV for internal and customer\-facing events.
* Lead in ticket processes and provide coaching for other Technicians when workflow deficiencies are identified.
* Have a deep understanding of defined team metrics and take actions based on current trends in Service.
* Document systems and ensure continuous process improvement.
* Display learning agility by actively seeking answers when technically challenged.
* Seek feedback from other Help Desk Technicians to optimize and improve support, maintaining a solid understanding of general user support needs and requirements.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum 1\+ years of experience in a Help Desk role with walk\-up service required; VIP support preferred.
* Demonstrable understanding of Mac OS from command line troubleshooting to resolving individual application failures.
* Advanced working knowledge of collaboration tools such as Slack, Teams, and Google Workspace.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Microsoft Exchange and/or Google Admin, including a firm understanding of Groups and permissions, is required.
* Knowledge of Windows, in issues ranging from resolving registry conflicts to troubleshooting system crashes and performance issues, is a plus.
* Familiarity with platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira, or Okta preferred.

**Skills**
----------

* Effective interpersonal communication skills with a high degree of empathy are a must.
* Can deliver outstanding customer service and provide simplified explanations of complex technical issues.
* Applies critical thinking and root cause analysis to complex end\-user requests and incidents.
* Ability to support others in a team environment, as well as the ability to work with limited supervision.
* Adapts well to ever\-changing needs and business processes.
* Ability to facilitate or teach is highly preferred.

**Compensation**
----------------



Estimated Pay Range: 40,000\-50,000 DOE with benefits

For more information, visit www.h2o.ai.

H2O.ai is at the forefront of the rapidly evolving MLOps landscape. This position is based in Montreal, Canada  

  

**What You Will Do**

* Engage with customers to identify and troubleshoot issues they face and answer technical questions.
* Analyze bug reports, reproduce issues, determine the root cause, and provide fixes.
* Provide design for new features focusing on the approach and patterns to solve the problem.
* Responsible for writing code along with relevant unit test cases.
* Contribute to end\-to\-end automated tests by ensuring that the newer changes have relevant test cases. Knowledge of Python would be beneficial in this area
* The company uses Kubernetes widely and working with Kubernetes would be an important aspect of the job.
* Review the design and code of other developers. Be engaged in the best software development practices and engage in improving the engineering efficiency of the team.
* Write Infrastructure Code using Terraform and Helm charts for any changes to infrastructure.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or a higher education degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field.
* Proven experience in Software Engineering with a minimum of 1 year of hands\-on experience in a similar role.
* Understanding of microservices patterns and strong design skills for large scale software development projects.
* Strong knowledge of Linux operating systems, Bash, file systems, command line, logging, and Linux file permissions.
* Experience in GoLang, Python, C\+\+, or Java (with a knowledge of Spring framework).
* At least 1 year of hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker.
* Knowledge of Relational Database Design.
* An understanding of Terraform and Helm.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Understanding of networking concepts and fundamentals (e.g. SSL, UDP/TCP, firewalls, and reverse proxies).
* Strong communication skills and comfortable being in a customer facing role.

**How to Stand Out From the Crowd**

* Experience with gRPC.
* Experience with Scala and Akka.
* Experience with Druid Database.
* Understanding of mainstream machine Machine Learning frameworks such as sklearn, pytorch and data science libraries like numpy and pandas.

**Why H2O.ai?**

* Market leader in total rewards
* Remote\-friendly culture
* Flexible working environment
* Be part of a world\-class team
* Career growth
* Base salary range: CAD 80,000 \- 100,000


H2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status or any other legally protected basis.  

  

H2O.ai is an innovative AI cloud platform company, leading the mission to democratize AI for everyone. Thousands of organizations from all over the world have used our cutting\-edge technology across a variety of industries. We’ve made it easy for people at all levels to generate breakthrough solutions to complex business problems and advance the discovery of new ideas and revenue streams. We push the boundaries of what is possible with artificial intelligence.  

  

H2O.ai employs the world’s top Kaggle Grandmasters, the community of best\-in\-the\-world machine learning practitioners and data scientists. A strong AI for Good ethos and responsible AI drive the company’s purpose.

**Description de l'entreprise**  

For over 40 years, LGI has built software that healthcare organizations depend on. AI is now at the heart of that work — not as a destination, but as the engine behind our next generation of mission\-critical solutions and our enduring mission: helping healthcare organizations perform at their best.


We're looking for exceptional people who are passionate about technology, relentless in their standards, and driven to push what's possible further. At LGI, curiosity isn't a nice\-to\-have, it's how we work. A good command of English would be considered an asset.

jobs.title: L2 IT Support - NETE
jobs.description:
Job title: L2 IT Support


Location: Lasalle, Montreal


Work Arrangement: Onsite


About the role


Join an IT team supporting all users (local and remote) at Weir Canada Inc. As a member of the Support Team, within the Testing and Infrastructure Support (TIS) Section, you will support, troubleshoot, deploy, and improve diverse technologies that enable business and operational capabilities for the company and its users.


What we do at Weir


At Weir, we combine engineering expertise, innovation, and technology to solve complex challenges for customers around the world. In this role, you'll apply those strengths in support of mission\-critical naval systems, contributing to the reliability, security, and performance of environments that are essential to Canada's maritime defence capabilities.


What you’ll do


In this role, you will provide IT support for the internal network which provides office automation and various tools to the users (local and remote). This position is ideal for a resourceful, hands\-on IT professional who enjoys solving problems and supporting users.


Make Your Impact


We value what you can do—not just where you’ve been. If you meet the goals of the role, we want to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities

* Provide network infrastructure support for all Microsoft Windows production servers by updating, maintaining and patching.
* Provide support for all Microsoft Windows workstations (desktops and laptops) by updating, maintaining and patching.
* Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot data backups via a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) / Veeam backup solution as well as ongoing disaster recovery support.
* Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve outages, bottlenecks, vulnerabilities, and other operational issues.
* Support core network and system services, including Cisco technologies, Microsoft Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and security platforms.
* Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, asset records, and technical procedures while ensuring compliance with security and operational best practices.
* Coordinate life\-cycling of all hardware on the network (i.e. servers, workstations, networking devices, security devices, etc.).
* Provide support to end users.


Must\-haves:

* DEC, Certification, or University Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
* Minimum 5 years of IT infrastructure and network support experience, including experience supporting enterprise network environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network and security issues.
* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, VMware, virtualization platforms.
* Experience with data backup and disaster recovery systems.
* Excellent customer service, organizational, and communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.


Mandatory Requirement: Canadian citizenship, with 10 or more years residing in Canada with no periods longer than six continuous months out of country, is absolutely necessary as part of the requirements to obtain a government security clearance to the minimum level of Secret


Nice\-to\-haves (desirable):

* Working knowledge of Citrix environments and Citrix NetScaler ADC Gateway appliances.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, security best practices, and vulnerability management.
* Experience supporting Cisco networking technologies, network protocols (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, QoS), firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and web/email security solutions.
* Can communicate equally well with senior leaders, engineers, technicians, and end users.


Why join Weir?


We live our values—we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.


We’re passionate about our purpose—to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world class engineering, materials science expertise and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end\-to\-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.


We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

*Benefits*

* Competitive pay
* Career development and study/learning support
* Access to global inclusion networks
* Regional and team\-specific benefits
* ShareBuilder program, allowing purchase of publicly traded shares of Weir
* Wellness support for you and your family
* Collaboration with global teams

jobs.title: Network Field Technician
jobs.description:
Technicien(ne) de réseau – Services sur le terrain

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| Montréal, Québec**  
**Type d’emploi :** Temps plein  
**Mode de travail :** Sur site / travail sur le terrain  
**Lieu :** Montréal et partout au Québec  
**Déplacements :** Des déplacements réguliers entre différents sites clients à Montréal et dans d’autres régions du Québec peuvent être requis.

À propos de Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. est un fournisseur de services gérés sur le terrain (Managed Field Services Provider – MFSP) en pleine croissance. Nous soutenons des fournisseurs de services TI (MSP), des entreprises technologiques, des équipes TI d’entreprise et des organisations possédant plusieurs établissements.

Nous assurons l’exécution technique sur site et faisons le lien entre les opérations TI à distance et les interventions physiques nécessaires chez les clients.

Nos services comprennent notamment :

* Soutien informatique et technique sur site
* Installation et déploiement de réseaux et de solutions de connectivité
* Déploiements d’infrastructures et projets technologiques
* Déploiement de matériel et de postes de travail
* Câblage structuré et infrastructure réseau physique
* Installations liées à la sécurité et à la conformité

Nos interventions sont réalisées à partir de bons de travail définis, de procédures professionnelles, d’exigences de documentation et de communications structurées avec les équipes TI à distance et les gestionnaires de projets.

Dans le cadre de notre expansion au Québec, nous développons un réseau professionnel de services techniques sur le terrain et recherchons des techniciens qui souhaitent évoluer avec l’organisation et participer progressivement à des mandats plus complexes.

Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) **technicien(ne) de réseau – services sur le terrain** capable de travailler de façon autonome chez les clients à Montréal et partout au Québec et de représenter Viverlink de manière professionnelle.

Il s’agit d’un poste pratique et terrain comprenant notamment l’installation d’équipements réseau, le dépannage, le câblage structuré, le déploiement de matériel et le soutien technique sur site.

Le travail est généralement effectué à partir de bons de travail détaillés et peut nécessiter une collaboration avec des ingénieurs à distance, des équipes MSP, des gestionnaires de projets et des représentants des clients.

La personne recherchée n’a pas besoin de tout maîtriser dès le premier jour. Nous recherchons surtout une personne possédant de bonnes bases techniques, une approche structurée du dépannage, une communication professionnelle et une réelle volonté d’apprendre et de progresser.

Responsabilités principalesRéseaux et infrastructure

* Installer, remplacer, configurer et tester des équipements réseau tels que des commutateurs, routeurs, points d’accès sans fil et équipements connexes.
* Effectuer du dépannage de base de la connectivité réseau à l’aide des concepts TCP/IP et des méthodes de diagnostic courantes.
* Identifier et résoudre les problèmes liés à l’infrastructure physique et au réseau.
* Effectuer des travaux de câblage structuré, notamment le cheminement, la terminaison, l’étiquetage, le raccordement et les tests de base.
* Installer et organiser les équipements réseau dans des baies, cabinets et environnements clients.
* Participer aux mises à niveau réseau, déploiements technologiques, remplacements de matériel et déploiements multisites.
* Effectuer le remplacement et l’installation de matériel conformément aux instructions approuvées.

Exécution des interventions sur le terrain

* Examiner les bons de travail et les exigences du site avant l’intervention.
* Se présenter sur place avec les outils, les informations et le matériel nécessaires.
* Respecter les instructions propres au client, la documentation technique, les procédures du site et les règles de sécurité.
* Travailler de façon autonome tout en maintenant une communication efficace avec les équipes techniques à distance.
* Signaler les problèmes qui dépassent la portée de l’intervention ou les compétences autorisées.
* Ne pas effectuer de modifications non autorisées dans les environnements des clients.

Documentation et rapports

* Maintenir à jour les informations relatives aux bons de travail et aux billets.
* Documenter les travaux effectués, les constatations, les changements apportés, les numéros de série et les observations pertinentes.
* Prendre les photographies et recueillir les autres éléments de preuve requis pour confirmer la réalisation des travaux.
* Communiquer clairement les problèmes, les obstacles et les travaux restant à effectuer.
* Produire des rapports d’intervention professionnels conformément aux exigences de Viverlink et du client.

Interaction avec les clients

* Représenter Viverlink de manière professionnelle chez les clients.
* Communiquer clairement avec les contacts sur place et le personnel du client.
* Gérer les attentes et fournir des mises à jour précises sur l’état de l’intervention.
* Maintenir une attitude professionnelle dans les bureaux, commerces, installations techniques et autres environnements clients.
* Protéger les renseignements des clients et respecter les exigences applicables en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité.

Qualifications recherchées

Nous recherchons des candidats possédant une expérience pratique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants :

Réseautique

* Bonne compréhension de base des réseaux TCP/IP.
* Connaissance des commutateurs, routeurs, points d’accès sans fil et du câblage réseau.
* Capacité à effectuer du dépannage de base de la connectivité.
* Compréhension de l’adressage IP, d’Ethernet, des concepts de VLAN et de la terminologie réseau courante.

Câblage et infrastructure physique

* Expérience en câblage structuré.
* Capacité à terminer, étiqueter, organiser et tester des câbles réseau.
* Connaissance des panneaux de brassage, baies, cabinets et systèmes de gestio

Fondée en 1956, Transport Bourassa est un chef de file dans le transport LTL, et dessert le Québec, les États\-Unis et l’Ontario. Notre engagement envers l’excellence opérationnelle repose sur une équipe talentueuse et dynamique.  


Sous la supervision du directeur TI, le technicien réseau et infrastructure assure l’administration, la configuration, l’entretien et le dépannage des équipements réseau et de sécurité de l’entreprise, tout en participant au support et au maintien de l’environnement informatique.  


Ce poste est une belle opportunité pour toi si tu recherches :  
Une entreprise où tu pourras développer ton talent et tes connaissances ;  
Un environnement technologique complexe où tu pourras relever des défis ;  
De la formation sur place de façon continue ;  
Des projets variés et dynamiques qui te feront sortir de ta routine.  
LES AVANTAGES DE VENIR TRAVAILLER AVEC NOUS :  
Assurances collectives et dentaire, 50% des primes payées par l’employeur ;  
Garderie subventionnée réservée aux employés et située sur les lieux du travail ;  
Cotisation versée par l'employeur à un REER ;  
Gym sur place accessible 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7 ;  
Terrasse sur le toit accessible pour des pauses au soleil ;  
Plusieurs récompenses tout au long de l’année (cadeau de Noël, dîner d’équipe, etc.) ;  
Party de Noël que tu ne veux surtout pas manquer !

RESPONSABILITÉS  
Assurer l'administration, la configuration, l'entretien et le dépannage des équipements réseau de l'entreprise.  
Administrer les commutateurs réseau, incluant la configuration des VLAN, trunks, ports et autres fonctionnalités nécessaires au bon fonctionnement de l'infrastructure.

Diagnostiquer les problèmes de couverture, de connectivité et de performance des réseaux sans\-fil.

Surveiller la performance, la disponibilité et la sécurité de l'infrastructure réseau et intervenir de façon proactive lors de problématiques.  
Effectuer le diagnostic et la résolution de problèmes réseau, notamment au niveau TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routage, Wi\-Fi, VPN et pare\-feu.  
Participer au déploiement et à l'installation des équipements réseau dans les différents bureaux de l'entreprise.

Offrir du support informatique aux utilisateurs au niveau des postes de travail, logiciels, périphériques et équipements informatiques.  
Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes liés aux environnements Windows.  
Fournir un support de base au niveau des serveurs Windows et des services Microsoft.  
Participer à la gestion des utilisateurs, groupes et ordinateurs dans Active Directory.  
Traiter les demandes de service et incidents à l'aide du système de billets.  
Collaborer avec les autres membres de l'équipe TI lors d'incidents ou de projets touchant les systèmes, le réseau ou la sécurité.  
Effectuer toutes autres tâches connexes pouvant être demandées.

Détenir un DEC ou DEP en informatique, réseautique ou toute autre formation pertinente.  
Posséder un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience en informatique, dont une expérience significative en réseautique d'entreprise.  
Bonne connaissance des principes de réseautique : TCP/IP, adressage IP, VLAN, routage, DNS, DHCP, NAT, LDAP et RADIUS.  
Expérience avec l'administration et la configuration de commutateurs réseau d'entreprise.

Connaissance de FortiAnalyzer et FortiAuthenticator, un atout important.

MDA Space (TSX : MDA) est un partenaire de mission de confiance de l’industrie spatiale mondiale qui crée l’espace entre ce qui est prouvé et ce qui est possible. À titre de pionnier de la robotique, des systèmes satellitaires et du renseignement géospatial, avec une histoire de 55 ans de premières mondiales et de plus de 450 missions, MDA Space est un chef de file mondial dans les domaines des satellites de communication, de l’observation de la Terre et de l’espace, ainsi que de l’infrastructure et l’exploration spatiale. L’équipe de MDA Space, qui compte plus de 4 000 experts du secteur spatial au Canada, aux États\-Unis et au Royaume\-Uni, possède les connaissances et le savoir\-faire nécessaires pour transformer la vision audacieuse du client en une mission réalisable, grâce à une combinaison unique d’expérience, d’excellence technique et d’émerveillement qui fait partie de notre ADN depuis le premier jour. L’administrateur de la sécurité sera chargé de l’amélioration continue, d’anticiper l’évolution des besoins des clients et les changements, de faire preuve de vision dans le développement des outils, des technologies et des processus, et d’être bien intégré au sein de la communauté afin de se tenir informé des meilleures pratiques.



Vous devrez démontrer votre capacité à concilier les implications juridiques des exigences de sécurité actuelles afin de garantir que les activités se poursuivent à tout moment dans le respect de la loi. Ce poste exigera également une capacité à trouver des solutions créatives aux problèmes.

* Surveiller les dates d’expiration et traiter les renouvellements des autorisations de sécurité existantes
* Dispenser des formations sur les procédures de sécurité aux employés de MDA.
* Rendre compte périodiquement des risques à la direction en mettant en évidence les problèmes et les cas complexes.
* Informer les gestionnaires internes de l’état d’avancement des autorisations de sécurité en cours
* Si nécessaire, prendre contact avec des références ou d’autres parties afin de vérifier les renseignements relatifs aux antécédents dans le cadre des procédures de sécurité
* Apporter son soutien dans les activités quotidiennes nécessaires à la bonne tenue des dossiers relatifs aux autorisations de sécurité.
* Tâches liées à la sécurité, telles que l’accueil des visiteurs, la mise en œuvre des exigences de sécurité, la communication avec d’autres partenaires sur des questions liées à la sécurité, ainsi que la coordination avec l’équipe des installations de MDA concernant les badges et les questions d’accès aux bâtiments.

**Qualifications et expérience requises :**

**Premiere Suites**

**Position Overview**

Premiere Suites is seeking a Level 2 IT Support \& Systems Administrator to provide day\-to\-day technical support and administration across our corporate technology environment.


This role serves as a primary point of contact for employee technology support and is responsible for maintaining user accounts, devices, Microsoft 365 services, access permissions, and a range of business applications. The successful candidate will combine strong customer service and troubleshooting skills with hands\-on systems administration experience and an ability to work independently in a multi\-system environment.


The position will also support the administration and ongoing improvement of key business platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk, SharePoint, Telus Business Connect, and other corporate applications.


**Key Responsibilities**

*End\-User Support \& Service Management*

* Provide primary triage, troubleshooting, and resolution of employee IT support requests and tickets.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, Microsoft 365, application, connectivity, printer, and peripheral issues.
* Provide remote technical support to employees across multiple locations.
* Set up, configure, deploy, and reconfigure laptops and other end\-user devices.
* Install and configure approved software, applications, plugins, and services.
* Escalate complex infrastructure, security, application, or integration issues when appropriate.
* Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, configurations, and recurring issues.
* Provide technical guidance to employees and help users effectively use company technology.

* Administer SharePoint access groups, permissions, and user access.
* Assist with Exchange Online administration, including mailbox access, mail flow troubleshooting, and related user issues.

*Device \& Endpoint Administration*

* Monitor and maintain end\-user devices to ensure they remain secure, patched, and operational.
* Ensure operating systems, antivirus/security tools, and approved applications remain current.
* Monitor device health, hardware condition, storage capacity, and performance.
* Use remote management tools to troubleshoot devices and deploy software or updates.
* Support device onboarding, replacement, reassignment, and offboarding processes.
* Maintain accurate records of company devices, configurations, and assignments.

*Business Systems Administration \& Support*

Provide day\-to\-day administration, user support, access management, and troubleshooting for Premiere Suites' business technology platforms, including Salesforce, Zendesk, SharePoint, Telus Business Connect, Adobe, DocuSign, QuickBooks Online, PayPal, GoDaddy, Cloudflare, Twilio, and other business applications adopted by the organization.

* Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve system usability and support processes.

*Salesforce \& Business Application Support*

* Work with business stakeholders to understand system issues and identify opportunities for improvement.

*Security \& Access Management*

* Follow established security policies and access\-management procedures.
* Assist with monitoring Microsoft Entra security alerts, risky sign\-ins, compromised accounts, and other user\-level security events.
* Support multi\-factor authentication and conditional access requirements.
* Ensure access is appropriately provisioned and removed during employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.
* Escalate security incidents or suspicious activity in accordance with company procedures.
* Support periodic access and permissions reviews.

*Network, Office \& Peripheral Support*

* Support printers, network\-connected devices, meeting\-room technology, and other office equipment.

Vous êtes passionné par la technologie et par le service à la clientèle?
  
Joignez\-vous à notre équipe TI dynamique et jouez un rôle clé en soutenant le bureau de Montréal sur place, tout en contribuant à des initiatives nationales qui assurent le bon fonctionnement et la connectivité de toute notre organisation.
  
Vos responsabilités
  
* Offrir un support en présentiel dans nos trois bureaux de la région de Montréal, en répondant aux incidents et aux demandes de service avec une approche orientée client.
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques, et escalader au besoin pour minimiser les interruptions.
* Documenter les systèmes et procédures TI, ainsi que toutes les étapes et solutions apportées, dans notre système de billetterie.
* Effectuer la maintenance préventive des systèmes, serveurs et équipements connectés au réseau.
* Participer à des projets majeurs de déploiement de systèmes et de solutions TI à l’échelle nationale.
* Collaborer à l’amélioration des processus et à l’optimisation des systèmes afin de rehausser l’expérience utilisateur.
* Gérer l’inventaire et contribuer au cycle de renouvellement des équipements.


Votre profil
  
* Diplôme professionnel ou technique en administration des TI, réseautique ou tout autre domaine connexe.
* 2\-5 années d’expérience dans un rôle similaire.
* Bilingue français\-anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, afin de soutenir l’ensemble de nos bureaux à travers le Canada.\*
* Maîtrise de Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, VMWare et des systèmes de billetterie.
* Capacité d’adaptation, flexibilité et volonté d’améliorer continuellement les processus.
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en résolution de problèmes, avec un fort esprit d’équipe.
* Sens marqué du service à la clientèle – vous aimez aider les gens et offrir une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle.
* La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise afin de soutenir nos activités à l’échelle canadienne et notre collaboration avec nos équipes et clients dans les autres provinces.


Pourquoi vous joindre à nous ?
  
* Un rôle avec un impact local et une portée nationale – soutien en personne pour la région de Québec et collaboration avec des collègues partout au pays.
* Un environnement collaboratif où vos idées sont écoutées.
* Des opportunités de développement professionnel et d’avancement en TI et en support client.
* Une organisation innovante et en pleine croissance qui investit dans ses talents et ses technologies.


Si vous souhaitez mettre à profit vos compétences techniques tout en offrant un service client hors pair, nous aimerions vous rencontrer !
  
  

Faire carrière avec nous, c’est…
  
* Une culture centrée sur la collaboration, axée sur le partage du savoir, le développement des talents et la qualité de nos réalisations.
* Une semaine de 37,5 heures, avec un horaire flexible et la possibilité de terminer à midi le vendredi.
* Une politique de télétravail hybride, favorisant la conciliation entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
* Les heures supplémentaires reconnues et compensées, soit en banque d’heures, soit rémunérées.
* Une rémunération globale compétitive, comprenant un salaire concurrentiel, un régime d’assurances complet et un programme de REER avec contribution de l’employeur.
* Un programme structuré de formation et de développement professionnel, soutenu par notre entité UniversiT, dédiée à la croissance technique et humaine de chaque employé.
* Un programme de mentorat sur mesure, adapté selon les niveaux d’expérience et les parcours professionnels.
* Des technologies à la fine pointe, dont le BIM et des outils collaboratifs modernes.
* Un programme « En quête d’équilibre », qui vise à favoriser le bien\-être global, la santé mentale et la productivité durable.


Nous adhérons aux principes d’équité en matière d’emploi, de diversité, d’inclusion et d’accessibilité dans l’ensemble de nos bureaux au Canada. Nous encourageons les candidatures de femmes, de personnes issues de minorités visibles, de peuples autochtones, de personnes en situation de handicap ainsi que de membres de la communauté 2SLGBTQIA\+.Des mesures d’adaptation sont offertes sur demande aux candidats participant à toute étape du processus de sélection.
  
Nous vous remercions de votre intérêt à joindre notre équipe. Veuillez noter que seules les personnes sélectionnées pour une entrevue seront contactées par l’équipe Talent.

jobs.title: Technicien TI terrain
jobs.description:
Technicien informatique junior \- Magasin et service sur la route

Nous recherchons une personne **débrouillarde, fiable et à l'aise avec l'informatique** pour se joindre à notre équipe à Sherbrooke.

Le poste combine du **support informatique en magasin** et des **interventions directement chez nos clients** dans la région.

Il s'agit d'un poste junior. Nous ne recherchons pas nécessairement un technicien avec plusieurs années d'expérience. Une personne ayant de bonnes connaissances personnelles en informatique, un étudiant ou un stagiaire avec une bonne capacité d'apprentissage pourrait très bien convenir.

Responsabilités en magasin

* Accueillir et aider les clients ayant des problèmes informatiques
* Effectuer des diagnostics de base sur les ordinateurs
* Installer et configurer des logiciels
* Installer et configurer des imprimantes
* Préparer de nouveaux ordinateurs
* Effectuer les mises à jour Windows
* Brancher et tester différents équipements informatiques
* Aider les clients avec des problèmes informatiques simples
* Effectuer du support technique de premier niveau
* Préparer du matériel avant une installation chez un client
* Documenter les interventions effectuées

Responsabilités sur la route

* Se déplacer directement chez les clients
* Installer ou remplacer des ordinateurs
* Installer des écrans, stations d'accueil et périphériques
* Installer et configurer des imprimantes
* Brancher ou remplacer des routeurs
* Installer ou remplacer des équipements Wi\-Fi
* Effectuer du câblage réseau simple
* Vérifier les connexions Internet et réseau
* Installer du matériel informatique
* Effectuer des diagnostics de base
* Suivre des procédures techniques fournies
* Communiquer avec un technicien senior lorsqu'une intervention devient plus complexe

Profil recherché

* Bonne connaissance générale des ordinateurs et de Windows
* À l'aise avec les imprimantes, routeurs et réseaux de base
* Débrouillard et capable de résoudre des problèmes simples
* Capable d'apprendre rapidement
* À l'aise avec le service à la clientèle
* Ponctuel et fiable
* Bonne présentation
* Capable de travailler seul lorsque nécessaire
* Capable de suivre des procédures techniques
* Permis de conduire valide

Une formation en informatique est un atout, mais **la débrouillardise, l'attitude et la volonté d'apprendre sont plus importantes que les diplômes**.

Type d'interventions

Les interventions sont principalement de niveau informatique de base à intermédiaire :

* Ordinateur qui ne démarre pas correctement
* Imprimante qui ne fonctionne plus
* Installation d'un nouvel ordinateur
* Installation de logiciels
* Configuration d'une imprimante réseau
* Remplacement d'un routeur
* Installation d'un point d'accès Wi\-Fi
* Problème de connexion Internet
* Branchement de matériel informatique
* Assistance à un client en magasin

Les problèmes plus complexes sont transférés ou escaladés à un technicien plus expérimenté.

Conditions

* Poste junior
* Travail en magasin et sur la route
* Région de Sherbrooke et environs
* Salaire : **20 à 23 $/h selon expérience**
* Formation et procédures fournies
* Possibilité de développer progressivement ses connaissances en informatique et en réseautique

Nous recherchons surtout une personne **fiable, débrouillarde, professionnelle avec les clients et intéressée à apprendre**.

Rémunération : 22,00$ à 25,00$ par heure

Heures prévues : de 10\.0 à 35\.0 par semaine

Avantages :

* Congés payés
* Heures d'arrivée et de départ flexibles
* Indemnité kilométrique
* Stationnement sur place
* Tenue Décontractée
* Travail à domicile

Lieu du poste : Déplacements fréquents

Service des technologies de l'information

La personne détentrice du poste assure l’installation, la configuration, la surveillance et la maintenance des serveurs et des systèmes d’exploitation Linux utilisés dans les différents environnements technologiques de l'Université. Elle participe également à l’automatisation des tâches récurrentes, à la documentation des environnements ainsi qu'à l'analyse et la résolution des incidents.


**TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES**


* Installer, configurer et maintenir les systèmes d’exploitation Rocky Linux sur des serveurs physiques ou virtuels ainsi que les services libres ou open source (Apache, Postfix, Redis, Rsyslog, HAProxy, etc.).
* Assurer l’installation, la configuration et la maintenance des bases de données (MariaDB, PostgreSQL).
* Assurer la surveillance des performances, la détection proactive des incidents et la résolution des problèmes techniques liés aux environnements Linux.
* Participer à la mise en place de scripts d’automatisation (Bash, Python, Cron, etc.).
* Assurer la conformité des systèmes (Git, Puppet).
* Collaborer au déploiement, à la sécurité et à la mise à jour des systèmes et serveurs.
* Documenter les procédures, les configurations et les interventions techniques.
* Offrir un soutien aux usagers internes pour les problèmes techniques liés aux environnements Linux.
* Participer aux stratégies de reprise après sinistre.

Il ne s’agit pas d’une liste complète et détaillée des tâches et responsabilités susceptibles d’être effectuées par une personne salariée occupant ce poste. Cependant, les tâches et responsabilités non énumérées ne doivent pas avoir d’effet sur la catégorie.


**EXIGENCES**


* Scolarité : Diplôme d’études collégiales en informatique ou scolarité équivalente.
* Expérience : Deux (2\) ans d’expérience pertinente.


*Toute combinaison de scolarit**é* *et d'exp**é**rience peut* *ê**tre accept**é**e si jug**é**e pertinente par l'employeur.*


**CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES**


* Excellente connaissance de Linux, MariaDB et PostgreSQL.
* Connaissance approfondie des serveurs physiques ou virtuels et des services libres ou open source (Apache, Postfix, Redis, Rsyslog, HAProxy).
* Bonne connaissance de Bash, Python, Cron, Git, Puppet.
* Bon sens de l’organisation, autonomie.
* Très bonnes aptitudes pour les relations interpersonnelles et l’esprit de collaboration.
* Très bonnes aptitudes pour les communications orales et écrites.
* Très bonne capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.


**MODE DE TRAVAIL**


* Télétravail, sauf besoins occasionnels de présence au bureau de Québec.
* La personne détentrice du poste peut être appelée à assurer, en alternance avec les autres membres de l’équipe d'infrastructure, des périodes de disponibilité à l'extérieur des heures normales de travail afin d'assurer la surveillance des systèmes.

Poste régulier.


**MILIEU INCLUSIF**


L’Université TÉLUQ souscrit aux programmes d’accès à l’égalité et l’équité en matière d’emploi et valorise la diversité et l’inclusion au sein de sa communauté.
