**Le télétravail en mode hybride est possible, en fonction des balises organisationnelles.**


L’entrée en fonction est prévue à la session d’automne 2026\.

  

Travailler au sein de la Direction de la mise en œuvre et de la migration (DMOM), c’est contribuer à un projet stimulant, le déploiement du Réseau gouvernemental de télécommunication (RGT). Le RGT a pour mandat d’offrir des services réseau à la fine pointe de la technologie à une clientèle de ministères et organismes publics afin de soutenir leurs activités de mission. Le déploiement du RGT est assuré par une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique dont tu pourrais faire partie!

Sous l’autorité du directeur de la DMOM, la personne titulaire collabore étroitement avec les parties prenantes pour la manipulation de données dans le cadre de la migration des services de la clientèle. Elle procède à des analyses fonctionnelles des besoins exprimés par l’équipe et effectue de la programmation en utilisant ou en intégrant des technologies identifiées :

* Participer à des travaux de conception.

* Autonomie et capacité à travailler avec un minimum de supervision.

o Diplôme d’études collégiales (DEC) en informatique;

Nous embrassons le changement et travaillons avec des esprits curieux pour réinventer l'avenir du travail. Rejoignez\-nous et concentrons\-nous ensemble sur ce qui est vraiment important : améliorer la vie grâce à de nouvelles idées et aux dernières technologies à travers le monde.

**Pourquoi vous allez adorer travailler chez Siemens !**

* Liberté et équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée : profitez de notre environnement de travail flexible avec des horaires flexibles, le télétravail et des espaces de travail numériques.

* Possibilité de contribuer avec vos idées innovantes et d'être rémunéré pour cela !

En tant que membre clé de l'équipe Performance et assistance technique, vous contribuerez à la réalisation des objectifs de notre contrat d'assistance technique et de fourniture de pièces de rechange (TSSSA). Votre rôle est essentiel pour garantir des performances élevées en matière de sécurité, de fiabilité opérationnelle et de satisfaction client, mesurées en termes de coût, de qualité et d'expérience client globale. * Préparer toutes les informations nécessaires pour les réunions quotidiennes/hebdomadaires avec le client, telles que les rapports, les téléchargements, les données de surveillance de la flotte, les relevés, etc.
* Soutenir les enquêtes sur les pannes et la réalisation des rapports d'analyse des causes profondes en servant de ressource pour collecter et distribuer les données relatives aux pannes et aux incidents aux utilisateurs finaux, en utilisant une application PowerApps pour normaliser la production des rapports d'incidents.
* Soutenir les efforts visant à améliorer la fiabilité et à assurer une amélioration continue afin de minimiser les temps d'arrêt et les coûts.

jobs.description:
**L’Expérience Aviva**
======================

Individuellement, nous sommes des personnes, mais ensemble, nous formons Aviva. Ces mots prennent tout leur sens lorsqu’ils deviennent nos valeurs : Bienveillance, Engagement, Collectivité et Confiance.  

  



À Aviva Canada, nous plaçons les gens au premier plan : nos employés, nos clients et nos collectivités. Nous sommes fiers d’une culture fondée sur la bienveillance, l’inclusion et la collaboration, où votre voix compte et votre développement est soutenu. Nous ne faisons pas que de l’assurance; nous faisons une réelle différence en protégeant ce qui compte le plus.  

  

  



**L’Opportunité**
=================

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un rédacteur production débutant en souscription automobile des entreprises. Notre équipe de souscription automobile commerciale est en pleine croissance et offre de multiples possibilités de développements. À titre de rédacteur production, vous êtes chargé de collaborer avec des partenaires internes et externes pour effectuer la sélection de nouvelles affaires et/ou procéder au traitement de diverses demandes, faisant partie de notre portefeuille existant (avenants et renouvellements).

  

  

**Ce que vous ferez**
=====================

* Analyser et sélectionner des nouvelles affaires en déterminant les besoins et les caractéristiques des risques reçus, pour s'assurer que ceux\-ci contribuent autant à nos objectifs de croissance qu’à la rentabilité.
* Nouer et entretenir des relations avec d’autres services et/ou avec des intervenants externes pour offrir un service supérieur à nos courtiers et clients.
* Préserver la qualité et la rentabilité du portefeuille automobile; référer à l’échelon supérieur les risques dépassant les limites de son pouvoir délégué.
* Aider à déceler les problèmes potentiels dans les ratios de sinistre et les tendances des risques, ainsi que toute autre anomalie; au besoin, appliquer des stratégies pour y remédier.
* Apprendre tous les systèmes et programmes informatiques employés en assurance des entreprises.
* Contribuer au maintien d’un environnement de souscription conforme en ce qui a trait aux taux déposés et aux règles.
* Entretenir ses connaissances sur les tendances de l’industrie, les nouveautés et l’évolution de la réglementation.

  

**Ce que vous apporterez**
==========================

* Études postsecondaires (affaires ou disciplines connexes), AEC en assurance de dommages
* Excellente maîtrise du français, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. \* ***Connaissance du français necessaire***
* Expérience en assurance de dommages
* Avoir débuté son cours de certification du PAA ou être en voie d'obtention (un atout)
* Connaissance fonctionnelle des domaines connexes à la souscription (indemnisation, gestion des risques, comptabilité, etc.).
* Connaissance des principes de sélection et d’analyse des risques, des contrats d’assurance, des programmes de tarification, des sources d’information sur les risques, du contenu des manuels de souscription des manuels techniques, des contraintes légales et des procédures de travail avec les outils informatiques.
* Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, facilité d’apprendre des nouveaux logiciels internes.
* Aptitude à interagir avec professionnalisme pour nouer des relations à long terme avec les courtiers et avec les clients.
* Aptitude à collaborer avec ses partenaires internes pour assurer l’excellence de l’expérience des courtiers et les clients.
* Autonomie et aptitude à se motiver soi\-même
* Aptitudes en vente et négociation
* Aptitude à prêter l’oreille aux besoins des courtiers et des clients pour y répondre efficacement.

  

**Ce que vous gagnerez**
========================

* Un programme de rémunération complet comprenant le salaire de base, l’admissibilité à une prime annuelle, un régime d’épargne\-retraite, un plan d’actionnariat, des avantages santé, des initiatives de bien\-être et des occasions de bénévolat.
* Un modèle de travail hybride et flexible.
* Des occasions exceptionnelles de développement de carrière.
* Un régime de vacances compétitif, avec la possibilité d’acheter 5 jours supplémentaires par année.
* Des programmes dirigés par les employés, axés sur le genre, la communauté LGBTQ\+, les origines, la diversité et l’inclusion.
* Des programmes de bien\-être en entreprise pour soutenir la santé physique et mentale de nos employés.

Cette offre d'emploi concerne un poste vacant existant qui a été affiché à la fois à l’interne et à l’externe.  

  



Aviva Canada pourrait utiliser des outils d'IA (intelligence artificielle) dans le but de faciliter le processus de recrutement pour, entre autres, filtrer, évaluer ou sélectionner les candidats pour un poste.  

  



Aviva Canada accepte les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et dispose d'un processus pour offrir des mesures d’adaptation du milieu de travail aux candidats ayant une incapacité fonctionnelle, et ce, à toutes les étapes du processus de recrutement et pendant l'emploi. Si vous avez un handicap qui nécessite que des mesures d’adaptation soient prises durant l'entrevue ou le processus le recrutement, veuillez communiquer avec votre partenaire de l’équipe Acquisition de talents à Aviva afin que les mesures appropriées puissent être prises.

jobs.title: Technicien support et formation utilisateurs
jobs.description:
TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d’**un Technicien support et formation utilisateurs** afin d’assurer le soutien opérationnel et l’accompagnement des utilisateurs .


Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue :

* Répondre aux demandes de soutien technique et fonctionnel;
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents utilisateurs;
* Assurer le suivi des billets de service;
* Produire les guides d’utilisation et la documentation de soutien;
* Concevoir et mettre à jour les vidéos de formation en français;
* Animer des séances de formation à distance;
* Participer aux activités de déploiement et d’accompagnement du changement

  

**Requirements**  

* Détenir une formation collégiale ou universitaire pertinente;
* Posséder une expérience en soutien technique ou en formation;
* Maîtriser les outils Microsoft 365;
* Posséder d’excellentes aptitudes en communication et en vulgarisation;
* Faire preuve de professionnalisme et d’autonomie;
* Posséder une excellente maîtrise du français parlé et écrit.

 **Benefits**  

* Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales
* Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
* Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
* Congés en cas de maladie et à l’occasion d’événements familiaux
* Outils informatiques adaptés
* Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
* Initiatives sociales et environnementales
* Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
* Cheminement de carrière


SALAIRE
Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.


LIEU DE TRAVAIL
Montréal\- Hybride


POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?
TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir\-faire et de notre créativité.


Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.


Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.


TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.


Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.


Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

jobs.title: Analyste junior Cybersecurite
jobs.description:
Depuis 1983, Pharmascience contribue à améliorer la santé et le bien\-être des patients au Canada et dans plus de 50 pays. En tant que 1er fabricant pharmaceutique de propriété canadienne et entreprise reconnue parmi les 50 meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada, nous croyons que notre succès repose avant tout sur le talent et l'engagement de nos équipes.


**Joignez\-vous à nous! Nous recrutons pour un poste d'Analyste junior en cybersécurité.**



En tant qu'analyste junior en cybersécurité, vous soutiendrez les opérations de sécurité de Pharmascience et contribuerez au renforcement de notre maturité en matière de cybersécurité. Sous le mentorat des analystes seniors, vous surveillerez et trierez les alertes de sécurité, participerez à la réponse aux incidents et développerez une expertise pratique de notre écosystème technologique, y compris la suite de sécurité Microsoft. Nous recherchons une personne motivée, dotée d'un esprit curieux et analytique, d'une grande rigueur et d'une réelle volonté d'apprendre et de progresser dans un environnement technologique complexe.

  


**Responsabilités:**


**Surveillance de sécurité et triage des alertes:**


* Surveiller les alertes de sécurité provenant de nos plateformes de détection (SIEM, EDR, sécurité courriel) et effectuer le triage de premier niveau.
* Analyser et qualifier les événements de sécurité, puis escalader les incidents confirmés selon les procédures établies.
* Documenter les investigations et maintenir des dossiers précis dans les outils de suivi des incidents.


**Soutien à la réponse aux incidents:**


* Participer à la réponse aux incidents de sécurité sous la supervision des analystes seniors.
* Exécuter les actions de confinement et de remédiation en suivant les playbooks établis.
* Contribuer à la documentation post\-incident et aux leçons apprises.


**Opération des outils de sécurité:**


* Utiliser et opérer quotidiennement la suite de sécurité Microsoft (Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, etc.).
* Contribuer au maintien et à la surveillance de l'état de santé des outils de sécurité (SIEM, EDR, NDR, etc.).
* Participer à l'amélioration des règles de détection et à l'automatisation sous supervision.


**Soutien à la gestion des vulnérabilités:**


* Participer aux analyses de vulnérabilités et au suivi des efforts de remédiation.
* Assurer le suivi auprès des équipes TI pour la résolution des vulnérabilités identifiées.
* Contribuer aux activités de sensibilisation à la sécurité au sein de l'organisation.


**Gouvernance, risques et conformité (GRC):**


* Soutenir les activités de conformité liées à la réglementation du secteur pharmaceutique.
* Contribuer à la préparation des audits de sécurité et à la collecte des preuves de conformité.
* Participer au maintien de la documentation et des procédures de sécurité.

  


**Compétences et expérience:**


* Expérience : 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité ou en TI (les stages, incluant les stages coop, sont considérés).
* Connaissances Microsoft : Bonne compréhension de la suite de sécurité Microsoft (par ex. Defender, Sentinel) et forte volonté d'approfondir cette expertise.
* Compétences analytiques : Bonnes capacités d'analyse, curiosité intellectuelle et rigueur dans l'application des procédures et la documentation des investigations.
* Connaissances techniques : Connaissances de base dans les domaines suivants : réseaux (TCP/IP), systèmes d'exploitation Windows et Linux, notions de gestion des identités et des accès (IAM) et principes fondamentaux de sécurité.
* Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais compte tenu des interactions avec des fournisseurs externes hors province.

  




**Qualifications:**


* Certifications : Les certifications de niveau débutant telles que CompTIA Security\+, Microsoft SC\-900, AZ\-900 ou SC\-200 constituent un atout.
* Expérience dans l'industrie : Une expérience ou un stage dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou dans un environnement réglementé constitue un atout.
* Compétences en script : Des connaissances de base en langages de script (par ex. PowerShell, Python) constituent un atout.

  


**Avantages de travailler chez Pharmascience :**


* Boni annuel de performance
* Programme de référencement interne allant jusqu’à 3000$
* Vacances et congés mobiles octroyés dès l'embauche
* Couverture d'assurance collective dès jour 1 incluant la télémédecine
* Régime de retraite compétitif avec contribution de l'employeur dès jour 1
* Programme d'aide aux employés
* Formation continue offerte
* Environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif
* Stationnement sur place
* Gym

#### **Expérience**


Obligatoire* 1 \- 3 years: 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité ou en TI.

#### **Scolarité**


Préféré* Baccalauréat or better in Informatique \- Computer Science
* Diplôme d'études collégiales or better in Informatique \- Computer Science

jobs.title: Junior Risk & Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies \- Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting\-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.
  
At QFG, we combine human\-centric collaboration with AI\-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.
  
Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.
  
  

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?
  
* Health \& wellbeing resources and programs
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work\-life balance
* Competitive compensation and benefits packages
* Work\-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
* Career growth and development opportunities
* Opportunities to contribute to community causes
* Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment


This job posting is for an existing vacancy.
  
  

We’re looking for our next Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst. Could It Be You?
  
Safeguard Questrade’s capital and operational integrity by executing critical risk and credit functions across regular and extended trading hours.
  
The Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst actively monitors real\-time trading activity and market conditions to mitigate financial and operational exposure. In this role, the analyst ensures client positions align with established risk parameters, addresses account variances, and proactively intervenes to prevent excessive leverage or speculative overexposure. By enforcing margin compliance and maintaining accurate equity balances, the analyst protects both client accounts and the firm from capital losses and negative equity scenarios.
  
  

Need more details? Keep reading…
  
**In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
  
* Monitor Portfolio Concentration: Continuously analyze portfolio exposure to identify and mitigate single\-asset or sector concentration risks.
* Manage Margin Operations: Issue margin calls and instruct the Trade Desk to execute liquidations or coverage for deficient accounts.
* Oversee Proprietary Positions: Track real\-time market risk, leverage, and position limits across proprietary trading accounts.
* Validate Options Processing: Review and confirm option assignments and exercises to ensure accurate settlement and risk alignment.
* Deliver Risk Notifications: Communicate time\-sensitive alerts to clients regarding margin deficiencies, registered account (RRSP) negative balances and liquidations
* Assess Foreign Exchange Exposure: Monitor cross\-currency risk stemming from dual\-currency (USD/CAD) account balances and fluctuations.
* Mitigate Complex Derivatives Risk: Evaluate multi\-leg option strategies and direct the Trade Desk to close out positions posing critical assignment or exercise risk prior to expiry.
* Administer Cease Trade Order (CTO) Restrictions: Coordinate with Compliance and Trade Desk to apply and revoke trading restrictions on halted securities and confirm cancellation of open orders ahead of the evening CTO cutoff.
* Provide Extended\-Hours Support: Act as the primary risk resource for internal teams (Trade Desk, Compliance, Client Success, Sales) during late and extended trading sessions.
* Manage Extended\-Hours Exposure: Monitor market fluctuations and risk limits during pre\-market and after\-hours trading sessions.
* Drive Ad\-Hoc Analytics \& Projects: Conduct ad\-hoc risk reporting, process evaluations, and departmental optimization projects as required.


So are YOU our next Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst? You are if you…
  
* Post secondary degree/diploma in related or quantitative field
* CSI course completion is an asset (CSC, DFC, OLC)
* 1\+ years of financial industry experience
* 1\+ years experience in Risk
* A strong interest in and knowledge of the financial industry
* Strong interpersonal skill, ability to articulate complex information in a clear and concise manner
* Excellent MS Excel skill and G\-suite, Python, SQL, Power\-bi experience is preferred
* Working towards CFA/FRM designation is preferred


Additional Information…
  
* Fix term contract \- 12 months
* Hours: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM EST


**Compensation Information:**  

* Base salary range: $55,000 \- $60,000
* The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full\-Time Permanent roles.


Sounds like you? Click below to apply!
  
i.e \#LI\-Hybrid, \#LI\-Onsite
  
  

At Questrade Financial Group of Companies, with multiple office locations around the world, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and accessible work environment. This is an environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Here, the unique skills and experience you bring will be valued. You will be supported and motivated, so that you can harness your unlimited potential. Our team reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and operate in. Having a collaborative and diverse team helps us push boundaries to bring the future of fintech into existence—not only for the benefit of our customers, but for those who build their career with us.

jobs.description:
**It has come to our attention that various international organizations or individuals have been offering false employment opportunities at Aecon Group Inc. Aecon Group Inc. employment policies and processes involve interviews, and candidates who seek employment are never required to pay us any sum of money. To do so would be contrary to our business conduct guidelines and ethical practices. We also do not extend formal offers of employment or execute employment agreements through social media or social chat platforms.**


**We take this matter extremely seriously and are working with the appropriate authorities to shut down such fraudulent schemes. Please remain vigilant on this matter and report any suspicious outreach to your local authorities and email any concerns to aecon@aecon.com**


Date: Sep 28, 2026
Location:
Hamilton, ON, CA
Operating Sector: Information Services
**Position Title:** **Jr. Specialist, IT Operations**
=====================================================

**Come Build Your Career at Aecon!**


Aecon delivers some of the most complex and impactful infrastructure projects — from transformative transportation networks to critical energy, industrial and nuclear programs. The projects we build connect communities and power future generations. With deep roots in North America and a strong footprint internationally, Aecon brings global expertise and proudly serves public and private sector clients through its Construction and Concessions segment.

  

Safety Always is not only our \#1 core value – it is the standard that anchors our culture. We believe the most ambitious projects deserve the most committed people. At Aecon, you won’t just build your career — you’ll help build what matters to enable future generations to thrive.

  

At Aecon, you can count on:


* **Safety Always.** Our number one core value. The safety of our people, projects, partners, and stakeholders is our priority focus – today and always.
* **Integrity.** We lead by example, with humility and courage.
* **Accountability.** We’re passionate about delivering on our commitments.
* **Inclusion.** We provide opportunities where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to contribute fully.
  

We deliver infrastructure with purpose, and our people are at the heart of everything we do. Aecon employees are incredibly proud to build some of the most impactful infrastructure of this generation – we call it **Aecon Proud**.

  

At Aecon we:


* Ensure you and your family receive the services and benefits needed to **support your mental, emotional, and physical well\-being.**
* Are intentional when it comes to investing in your development. We help you build your career and advance your skills through our **Aecon University, tuition reimbursement, and Leadership Programs.**
* Are committed to creating work environments focused on mutual respect, teamwork, collaboration, and new ideas, through meaningful initiatives, training, partnerships with Veteran groups, our **Aecon Women in Trades** and diversity programs, as well as our **Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)**, to ensure we are building with top talent and harnessing our collective strengths within every aspect of our culture.
* Operate responsibly by managing risk, safety, and environmental considerations across all our projects and surrounding communities.
  

Our success is built on the passion, expertise, and dedication of our people. Together, we embrace strong execution, innovation, and continuous improvement — values that come to life through the unique talents and collaborative spirit of every team member. If you’re inspired to make a difference through future\-building projects, join our best\-in\-class team.

  

**What is the Opportunity?**
The Hamilton LRT Alliance has been selected by Metrolinx as the development partner for the Hamilton LRT – Package 1: Civil \& Utilities. Under the alliance model, Aecon provides construction capability and resources as part of an integrated team, working collaboratively with all alliance participants to progress design, cost, and construction schedules during the project’s development phase.
The Hamilton LRT isn’t just a transit project—it’s reshaping how a city connects, grows, and moves. Join us in being part of a dynamic team building critical infrastructure that will leave a lasting legacy for generations to come.  

Reporting to the Manager, IT Operations, the Jr. IT Operations Specialist is responsible for day\-to\-day operational IT support, requests and project setup support for Project offices, job sites \& networks.

* Support key offices and job sites as assigned
* Provide remote and in person IT support to all end users as needed day\-to\-day
* Setup and deployment of equipment, making CMDB updates as necessary
* Design and manage job site setups, engaging other internal teams and vendors as necessary
* Creating and managing diagrams for cabling and workstation requirements, meeting room equipment etc.

* Participate in the creation of estimates for all new project job sites

* Demonstrable experience with and training on multiple technologies including (but not limited to) HP, Cisco, Juniper, Lenovo and Apple hardware and software
* Familiarity with ITIL is considered an asset

* Experience with setup, deployment and support/management of large printer fleet

jobs.title: Retail Support Agent (6-months)
jobs.description:
**YOU'RE ALL ABOUT** ***going*** **THAT** ***extra*** **MILE TO** ***help*** **OTHERS.**

**The Opportunity**  

Are you the kind of person who always gets stopped on the street and asked for directions? You know, one of those friendly, approachable types who always have a smile on their face and are ready to help someone in need. If this sounds like you, then you’re just the kind of person we’re looking for in our Member Services team. We need someone who can provide exemplary customer service and support to our Member Services Teams. A welcoming face who goes above and beyond to help our members with retail items and membership products and services. You might say that our ideal candidate is part detective, part problem\-solver, part psychic and a local travel bug — in other words, you enjoy taking the time to understand and anticipate members’ needs then dig deep to find just the right answers, no matter what team in the city needs your particular set of skills.

**A Place to Belong**  

AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one\-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well\-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!


Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:

* Work for one of the most trusted brands in Canada.
* Competitive wage.
* Benefits if you choose to receive them (with payroll deductions).
* Vacation pay is added to each paycheque.
* Great AMA discounts.
* Unlimited learning opportunities!

* You love the fact that every day on the job is different from the last – and you’re excited at the opportunity to always be learning something new, often in new environments too.
* You enjoy being a part of a team whose experience and expertise is there to tap into, and you like sharing your own knowledge and skills as well.
* You’ve got mad skills when it comes to thinking on your feet in a fast\-paced environment.
* You welcome the opportunity to face a challenge head\-on and know how to handle even the toughest situation with patience and grace.
* You've made it your personal mission to take customer service to the highest possible level.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Report to the Assistant Manager, Member Services.
* Provide outstanding customer service and support to our members, keeping on top of and promoting appropriate AMA products and services.
* Complete membership, basic registry and entry level travel product and service transactions – accurately, confidentially and in a timely manner.
* Professionally engage members in a welcoming and positive manner to determine their needs and take care of retail transactions within our centers. (Retail transactions include but are not limited to: membership support, gift card sales, movie pass sales, International Driver’s Permits, road test check\-ins, Parks Canada passes, Driver’s Education programs, ski passes, passport photos, basic registry services, and other retail items sold in center).
* Provide back\-up for our Member Services Coordinators.
* Various Admin tasks as assigned including assisting agents with hold support, document printing, inventory, gift card counts, custodian, cash out and other duties as assigned.
* Assess member needs and match with the appropriate representative best qualified to complete the relevant product and/or service. This will be most critical where specialization is required for complex customer needs.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* You’re at least 18 years old with a high school diploma and have an updated Police Information Check (PIC). You’ve got strong communication skills, and sales or customer service experience. Along with a commitment to learning.
* You’re no newbie to customer service with 1\-2 years of retail and/or administrative experience.
* Your awesome attitude and genuine desire to help people is what matters most in this job.

**Belonging Matters Here**  

AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact **recruitment@ama.ab.ca**. We’ll work with you to feel supported throughout your journey with us.

* 

**WORK MODEL:**


In\-Office* 


We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: System Support Analyst
jobs.description:
Location: Etobicoke, ON, Canada
  

Date Posted: Sep 29, 2026
  

Job ID: R31047
  

Job Status: Full\-Time


  
**Description**


As The System Support Analyst, reporting to the System Support Team Lead, you will ensure all end‑user devices operate smoothly and efficiently. This role handles a wide range of technical responsibilities, including device setup, software installation and configuration, and troubleshooting complex hardware and software issues. Support is provided both in person and remotely.
  

  

Success in this position requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, user‑friendly way. The analyst will work with diverse IT infrastructure such as laptops, mobile devices, printers, networks, cloud services and may also contribute technical insights to projects as needed.
  

  

This is a 6 month fixed term position to begin with a possible extension. If you are interested please apply to join our True Blue Team today in Toronto, ON.
**Essential Responsibilities:**


* Installing, configuring, and maintaining end point devices. This includes setting up and maintaining printers, workstations, networks, cloud\-based services, audio/video equipment and peripherals
* Installing, configuring, and maintaining various software applications. This may include troubleshooting complex technical issues related to productivity software, communication tools, and business applications.
* Proficient with and strong knowledge of all operating systems such as Windows, Android \& iOS and be able to troubleshoot related issues and resolve them quickly and efficiently
* Provide end\-user support for hardware, software and network issues, this includes troubleshooting hardware and software components, replacing faulty equipment, identifying the root cause through thorough review and assessment and make recommendations for implementation of appropriate solutions. Partners and collaborates with Internal and external technical resources as required (external vendors or Internal IT SME’s)
* Respond to and resolve IT incidents and service requests in a timely and efficient manner, ensuring that end\-users are informed of the status of their requests
* Strong understanding of IT security principles and practices, including antivirus software, firewalls, and security policies and procedures to maintain a secure environment
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure, including switches, routers, and firewalls, and the ability to troubleshoot complex networking issues and ensure that the organization’s IT systems are running and operating smoothly
* Responsible for setting up and maintaining IT infrastructure, including printers, networks, and cloud\-based services, ensuring these systems are optimized for performance and security
* Assists with continuously reviewing and improving complex IT processes and procedures, i.e. network design, systems configuration to identify and recommend updates to ensure that they are efficient, effective, and aligned with industry best practices and standards (ITIL based)
* Provides technical advice and guidance to stakeholders such as Executives, Service Desk team etc. on potential issues

**Qualifications:**


* 5\+ years experience within a similar position dealing with executive support
* Superior communication skills and proven experience working with executives, key stakeholders and providing exceptional customer service
* 2‑year Technical Diploma in Computer Science required, Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering is an asset
* Proficiency with cloud applications and tools, including Microsoft Azure, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Endpoint, Exchange Online, Cloud Printing, Fax Systems, and ServiceNow
* Strong knowledge of on\-premises services, such as Microsoft Active Directory and File Servers
* Experience with collaboration platforms like Microsoft Teams and Zoom
* Expertise in cloud\-based software, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Visio, and Project
* Familiarity with networking technologies and tools, such as Cisco, Fortinet, Meraki, and various internet connection types (cellular, wired, point\-to\-point, satellite)
* Strong understanding of operating systems, including Windows 10/11, Android, and iOS
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues efficiently
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to non‑technical users
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work effectively under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment

**Work Conditions:**


* Ability to lift up to 50lbs
* This is an in office role for 5 days a week along with occasional travel to project sites when required

Whether we're an extension of a client's existing IT team, or managing outsourced IT structure, we're customer obsessed and aim to provide best in class services. If you're passionate about delivering best in class technical support and have a strong customer service orientation, we would love to hear from you!

* Perform initial troubleshooting for managed network, connectivity, VoIP, SD\-WAN, Fortinet and Cato\-related customer issues, escalating where appropriate

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering preferred, equivalent experience considered

* Comfortable using knowledge and judgment to problem solve independently
* Enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment

jobs.description:
**Northern Computer Inc. (NCI)** is a leading Managed IT Services Provider dedicated to delivering exceptional technology solutions and support to businesses across British Columbia and Alberta. We pride ourselves on building strong client relationships, maintaining a collaborative team culture, and providing opportunities for professional growth and development.


We're looking for a motivated and customer\-focused Field Service Technician to join our growing team. If you enjoy working directly with clients, solving technical challenges, and being on the move rather than sitting behind a desk all day, we want to hear from you.

**Job Summary:**


Northern Computer’s Field Services team delivers on site expertise that keeps our clients productive and confident in their technology. You’ll be the face on site when it comes to resolving issues, completing proactive visits, installing gear, closing the loop in our systems, and partnering closely with the Service Desk, NOC/SOC, Projects, and Account Management. **What You’ll Do:**

* Perform onsite technical support as the primary technician for client environments, handling Tier 1\- 2 issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and validate fixes for endpoint, network edge, and infrastructure problems.

* Execute device adds/moves/changes and support scheduled deployments in coordination with NOC, Service Desk, and Projects.
* Maintain high\-quality ticketing practices: clear documentation, time entries, photos, notes, and next steps.

* Communicate clearly with end users and site contacts, providing professional, confidence building onsite interactions.
* Ensure that no hardware is left behind and maintain safe, well\-organized tools, loaner kits, and the company vehicle.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Minimum 3 years of IT Field Services experience.
* Minimum 3 years supporting business technology environments.
* Tier 2 to Tier 3 technical support experience.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.

jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  

For over 70 years Buckland has been working to help companies across the world experience global trade in a better way. Buckland employs a unique approach to global trade that focuses on combining trusted technologies and talented people that know how to use them. As a customer\-focused company, Buckland provides customers with a single source of unmatched Customs Brokerage (Canadian, US, Mexican), Trade Managed Solutions, Freight Forwarding, Trade Technologies and Warehousing/Distribution Services. Buckland strives to provide customized services in a memorable way.
  
  

Buckland is looking for an IT Support Specialist (St Thomas Office)
  
  

What you’ll be doing
  
This position is responsible for following ITIL/ITSM best practices, to identify, resolve issues and deliver improvements. The IT Support Specialist will engage with lines of business and teams to prioritize and complete service requests and support incidents and internal and external OLA’s and SLAs are met. IT Support Specialist are involved in remote and onsite support, documentation, constructing reference material, and provide trainings as necessary.
  
  

What we can offer you
  
* Competitive salary, benefits package, and matching retirement plan
* Compensation range: $55,000– $65,000 annually (subject to experience)
* A friendly, collaborative work environment
* Opportunities for professional development \& ongoing learning
* A chance to be part of a growing organization
* On\-site position


Key Responsibilities
  
* Field incoming helpdesk requests from end users via ticketing system, phone or in person.
* Installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of Windows systems.
* Assist with configuration, installation and maintenance of software, hardware, and telecommunications services such as: computers, software applications, printers, telephones, servers, and general office equipment.
* Participate in reviewing systems, testing, and deploying updates.
* Follow ITIL/ITSM best practices for incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
* Taking team and staff needs and improving solutions through planning, design, review, and installation tasks.
* Creating detailed documentation of IT resources and processes and updating support documentation with all daily tasks and as the product support grows.
* Fulfil requests coming from team members and leads to ensure hardware, software and network are available 98\+% of the time on a 24/7 basis, excluding scheduled downtime.
* Collaborate with other IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of support services and incident management processes.
* Provide afterhours on\-call support as required.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.


What we need from you
  
* Computer Science degree or diploma or equivalent education and work experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant work experience in a technical support position.
* ITIL Foundations certification.
* Knowledge of ITSM processes, tools, and best practices.
* Networking fundamentals or proven networking certification.
* Microsoft 365, PowerShell scripting and Azure experience.
* Experience with Virtual server technologies such as VMWare, Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Exchange online or equivalent cloud\-based system.
* Experience with Windows enterprise applications, Active Directory, IIS, file servers, etc.
* Experience in Microsoft SQL Server.
* Desktop support for PC environment supporting Windows 10 / 11 and Microsoft Office suite.
* Networking involving multiple platforms, Cisco/Nortel/HP/Dell/other vendors.
* Excellent problem solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Must be legally eligible to work for the Company at all times.
* Valid Passport ability to occasionally travel if required to other offices locations in CAD/USA/MEX.


Want to apply? Get in touch today
  
Please visit www.Buckland.com to apply to this current and open vacancy and to learn more about Buckland and the services we provide. The career page will highlight all current open positions and they can be found in this link. When applying, ensure to have your most up to date resume and all relevant documents related to your application ready to be uploaded.
  
Buckland provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on any protected ground under applicable human rights legislation. Applicants do not require CAD or USA work experience but for some positions may require CAD or USA standard regulations knowledge and experience. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, placement, promotion, compensation, transfer, leaves of absence, layoff, recall and termination.
  
Buckland may use artificial intelligence from time to time to screen, assess, or select applicants for employment, including for this position.
  
Buckland will work with and accommodate persons with disabilities throughout the entire recruitment, selection, and on\-boarding process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition at TA@Buckland.com
  
As we receive a high volume of applications, we’re only able to contact candidates selected to move forward. While we truly appreciate your interest, we are unable to respond to general inquiries regarding application status. Thank you for your understanding.

If you are looking for a fast\-paced career, serving enterprise customers and managing diverse IT projects, we invite you to join us.

Reporting to the Service Desk Manager and working closely with the Provisioning Team Lead, the Deskside Support Technician is responsible for providing technical support to end\-users, troubleshooting issues, deploying and maintaining hardware at client sites, and providing excellent customer service in line with client service level agreements (SLAs).

* Submit regular performance and incident reports

**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as an IT Support Technician and become a vital part of ensuring seamless technology operations across our organization! In this role, you will provide proactive technical support, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and assist users in optimizing their digital tools. Your energetic approach will help foster a productive environment where technology empowers every team member to succeed. Whether working on desktop support, network configurations, or resolving technical glitches, you’ll play a key role in maintaining our IT infrastructure’s efficiency and security.

**Responsibilities**

* Deliver prompt and effective technical support to end\-users via help desk channels, resolving issues related to operating systems, software applications, and hardware components.
* Troubleshoot computer hardware problems, including desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals, ensuring minimal downtime.
* Configure and maintain computer networks, including LAN (Local Area Network), VPN (Virtual Private Network), firewalls, and Wi\-Fi connectivity to ensure secure and reliable access.
* Assist with operating system management across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, performing updates and system optimizations.
* Manage incident tickets using ServiceNow or BMC Remedy to document issues accurately and track resolution progress.
* Support software troubleshooting efforts for applications like Microsoft Office suite and other enterprise tools.
* Collaborate with team members to implement security measures such as firewall configurations and network access controls to protect organizational data.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of operating systems including Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
* Experience with computer networking concepts such as LAN setup, VPN configuration, firewalls, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
* Proficiency in using ticketing systems like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy for incident management.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly explain technical solutions to non\-technical users.
* Familiarity with help desk procedures and customer service best practices to deliver a positive support experience.
* Ability to troubleshoot software issues related to operating systems and productivity applications like Microsoft Office.
* Understanding of hardware components including desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals.

Join us in delivering exceptional IT support that keeps our organization running smoothly! Your enthusiasm for technology combined with your technical expertise will make a real difference in empowering our teams every day.

Pay: $20\.00\-$35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

At Maximus Canada, we share an authentic desire to do something meaningful to help others succeed. We apply our deep operational expertise, technology innovation, and digitally enabled citizen engagement in new ways and help governments solve complex problems.
  
  

Maximus Canada collaborates with government partners to deliver a variety of citizen services, including healthcare administration, federal and provincial programs, and contact centre services across Canada. We offer eHealth solutions through our Medigent® suite of products, as well as technology consulting and business process services. We leverage our deep operational expertise, technology innovation, and digitally enabled customer engagement to deliver fast solutions. Today, we proudly support many federal, provincial and municipal programs across the country powered by Canadians.
  
  

Globally, Maximus has operations in India, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, and the United Kingdom. Our mission is to affect fundamental change in the lives of every individual with whom we engage and at every touchpoint. But ultimately, what we do is improve people’s lives.
  
  

Maximus Canada is proud to announce it has been named one of British Columbia’s Top Employers for 2026\. This recognition highlights the company’s ongoing commitment to cultivating an engaged and people centered workplace across its operations in BC and nationwide.
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Service BC is a citizen centric front\-line support service administered by Maximus Canada to assist residents and visitors to the province with information on the hundreds of programs and services the government offers. The strategic focus of Service BC is continual modernization and channel and service expansion to ensure citizens are able to access services from a single source in the format they choose. Service BC has leveraged industry best practices and introduced leading edge technology to become a leader in its sector. A recent recipient of the Benchmark Portal Centre of Excellence designation and winner of the 2019 Service to the Citizen Award in the international category, through the US Service to the Citizen Awards program that recognizes excellence in public service delivery.
  
  

About the Role
  
  

Service BC Help Desk Customer Service Agents (CSR) spend their day answering enquiries from the general public and Government Agents who have questions related to BCeID, BC Services Cards, Mobile Video Chat, PayBC, as well as BC Business Registries and Online Services. Our telephone system queues, monitor upwards of 750 calls per day; therefore, CSR’s are expected to meet call handling targets.
  
  

CSR’s are required to learn and use a variety of computer applications and log service and technical tickets when appropriate which require a high level of accuracy.
  
  

Service BC Help Desk Agent’s also are fully compliant with FOIPPA and maintain the highest standards when dealing with business sensitive and confidential information.
  
  

As the ‘Face’ of Service BC Help Desk CSR’s handle calls pleasantly and professionally. As calls can be contentious in nature professionalism must be maintained.
  
  

What a Typical Week Looks Like
  
  

* Respond to queries in order to provide end user support. This will include troubleshooting and/or escalating/delegating to appropriate levels of support as defined by the incident
* Provide first call resolution by actioning all Tier 1 level requests, while meeting or exceeding our productivity targets (ex. AHT and TSF)
* Understand and comply to Maximus, legislated and client policies and work procedures accurately, 95% of the time to meet our Quality SLR and to provide excellent customer service
* Adhere to your work commitments and daily schedule 95% of the time so that Maximus can meet its business goal efficiently
* Manage your interactions with callers, clients and colleagues respectfully, collaboratively and professionally to contribute to a harmonious and productive work environment
* Answer and complete public enquires within 300 seconds to meet our Average Speed of Answer


What You Bring
  
  

* High school diploma or GED Equivalent, may be subject to Standardized testing
* Proficiency in basic computer skills, MS Office and Outlook and the ability to operate standard office equipment
* Call center experience or equivalent
* Privacy and security of personal information


Understand the Principles of
  
  

* Call control and customer situational judgment
* Customer Service
* Plain language communication
* Professional, pro\-social inter\-relations
* Privacy and security of personal information

* This is an auxiliary position working as and when required
* For internal applicants, this will be a temporary assignment
* Please note that this is an on\-site position based in Victoria, BC

Support Delivery \- Ontario \- Remote

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post\-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early\-stage startups to established global enterprises.


**About the Role**


The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go\-to\-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.


We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem\-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high\-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems\-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.


Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day\-to\-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.


This Toronto\-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in\-office arrangement.


**In this role, you will:**


* Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issuesance degradation, and production incidents.
* Provide end\-to\-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.
* Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.
* Own the customer\-specific response to high\-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross\-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post\-incident follow\-through.
* Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.
* Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Partner with Go\-to\-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.
* Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow\-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.
* Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.
* Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account\-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.
* Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.
* Translate recurring customer pain into clearance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.
* Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI\-powered automation.
* Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**


* Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands\-on diagnosis of complex production issues.

Technical Support Specialist – Software
jobs.description:
**About Mobiltex**

Mobiltex is an IIoT and software company delivering remote monitoring and software solutions that help maintain pipeline health for industries delivering critical services. Individual solutions target corrosion prevention, gas pressure management, and water network optimization, primarily serving midstream and downstream energy operators, and water utilities.

Mobiltex is a high\-growth company in an active phase of product and organizational scaling, with potential for M\&A, as well as a growing international footprint. This is an environment that rewards people who can build structure where it doesn’t yet exist, and drive commercial output as the organization scales.

**Role Summary**

The **Technical Support Specialist** **– Software** is a frontline role responsible for delivering technical support and training, while serving as a critical link between the customers and service, engineering, sales, and product teams. It combines software support expertise with customer engagement to support deployment, adoption, and ongoing performance of IoT solutions across our energy and water verticals.

This is an early\-career role in the support team, reporting to the Support Manager. It's a strong entry point for someone with technical skills who enjoys working with people to build product and troubleshooting expertise and grow into a senior support or implementation role over time. The primary focus will be support of Mobiltex software and will include some support of Mobiltex hardware devices. This position is also a great fit for corrosion/CP field professionals looking to move into support, or for IT helpdesk, telecom, electronics, or customer service people with strong technical curiosity; we'll train the domain side either way.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support across the software portfolio: primarily CorInsights, and also FloInsights, Osprey, and future products. Secondarily, provide hardware support as needed for CorTalk, FloPath, and future products.
* Respond to support tickets with a focus on responsiveness, clarity, and resolution quality.
* Communicate clearly with customers, translating technical issues into understandable terms and helping customers use our products successfully.
* Diagnose problems methodically and identify root causes, workarounds, and solutions.
* Escalate complex or high\-impact issues to senior support, management, sales, or engineering.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with the product, development, and QA teams as needed to investigate bugs and contribute to ongoing software improvements.
* Monitor key performance metrics and service levels to ensure you consistently meet or exceed personal targets and company targets.
* Utilize and continuously improve internal documentation, knowledge bases, and support protocols by following Mobiltex standards for formatting, creation, and peer review.
* Participate in customer meetings or presentations when needed to resolve high\-stakes support issues or build customer confidence.
* Provide occasional after\-hours or on\-call support for critical or high\-impact issues.
* Minimal travel (5% or less) for customer meetings, team meetings, and industry events.

**How You'll Work**

You will use phone, email, and ticketing systems to communicate with customers and track resolutions and defects internally. There will be occasional opportunities for on\-site customer engagement. Strong verbal and written communication skills are fundamental to success.

You'll learn and use AI tools like Claude and Copilot alongside standard support tools to work faster and more consistently: drafting case responses, summarizing ticket threads before escalation, searching the knowledge base for similar issues, and generating first\-draft articles from resolved cases for peer review and publishing.

If you are based in Calgary, your first three months will have more office\-based work to get hands\-on training and learn alongside the team. After that, you'll work a hybrid mix of office and home days.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in software customer support or service technician roles.
* A bachelor's degree, diploma, AMPP CP1 or CP2 certification, certification in a related field, or equivalent experience in pipeline monitoring, industrial software, or related fields.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience providing phone or email support to customers in a remote work environment and/or with remote teams.
* Experience with support ticketing systems, remote desktop tools, and diagnostic utilities (Salesforce, Teams, Slack, Jira, Confluence).
* Troubleshooting skills with knowledge of SaaS platforms, APIs, and database technologies.
* Knowledge of and/or willingness to use, create, and promote knowledge bases and AI tools (Claude, Copilot).

Location: Calgary; Remote considered

**What Mobiltex Offers**

* A role in a company actively reshaping how critical infrastructure is monitored and managed.
* Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over commercial messaging and market presence.
* A function with clear scope and a defined growth path as Mobiltex scales – with senior leadership visibility from day one.
* Competitive compensation including base salary and performance incentives.
* Hybrid flexibility with periodic travel to trade shows, team meetings and customer events.

Mobiltex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to mental or physical disabilities, family status, marital status, sex or gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, religion or creed, nationality or citizenship, national or ethnic place of origin, ancestry, or race or color.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (Microsoft & End-User Support)
jobs.description:
**About RebalanceMD**

RebalanceMD Victoria is a specialty care clinic where physicians, surgeons, physiotherapists, and allied health professionals work together as one multidisciplinary team. At RebalanceMD, patients can access coordinated care through an integrated model designed to support assessment, treatment, recovery, and ongoing health. Behind that care is a strong technology foundation and commitment to innovation that keep our clinical and administrative teams connected, secure, and able to deliver an exceptional patient and provider experience.

We are seeking a Technical Support Specialist who is passionate about technology and service, and who understands the critical role IT plays in a healthcare environment. This role is instrumental in ensuring our clinical and administrative teams can operate seamlessly, securely, and without disruption.

**About the Role**

As a Technical Support Specialist at RebalanceMD, you will be the first point of contact for technical support across the organization. You will provide timely, professional assistance to a diverse group of users including doctors, clinicians, administrative staff, and leadership.

This role requires a strong foundation in Microsoft technologies, hands\-on support of end\-user hardware, and the ability to work within a fast\-paced clinical environment where responsiveness and reliability are essential. Experience with Apple devices is also valuable, as our environment includes a mix of platforms.

Success in this role requires excellent communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a commitment to supporting healthcare teams in delivering high\-quality patient care.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Tier 1/2 support to clinical and administrative staff via in\-person, phone, email, and ticketing system
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues with a strong sense of urgency and professionalism
* Support Microsoft technologies including Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint), and Active Directory/Entra ID
* Set up, configure, and maintain end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices
* Support both Windows\-based systems and Apple devices within a clinical and office environment
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, equipment setup, and access management
* Ensure all systems and devices comply with organizational security standards and healthcare privacy requirements (e.g., PHIPA/PIPEDA awareness)
* Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, resolutions, and IT procedures within the help desk system
* Perform routine maintenance, updates, and patching to ensure system stability and security
* Support clinical workflows by minimizing downtime and ensuring critical systems remain operational
* Educate staff on best practices for technology use, security awareness, and basic troubleshooting

**Qualifications \& Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and a minimum of 2 years' experience in an IT help desk or end\-user support role

* Strong experience supporting Microsoft environments, including Windows OS and Microsoft 365
* Working knowledge of Entra ID user and device management
* Experience supporting end\-user hardware such as laptops, desktops, printers, and mobile devices
* Familiarity with Apple macOS and basic troubleshooting of MacBooks
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including Wi\-Fi, VPN, and TCP/IP
* Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly and respectfully support non\-technical users in a clinical setting
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to prioritize and respond effectively in time\-sensitive situations
* A customer\-focused mindset with a high level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail

**Nice to Have**

* IT certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Microsoft certifications, or similar
* Experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, JAMF, SCCM)
* Previous experience in a healthcare or clinical environment
* Familiarity with electronic medical record (EMR) systems or healthcare applications
* Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy best practices in healthcare

**Compensation**

RebalanceMD offers competitive compensation, a beautiful and bright office, amazing and supportive team of co\-workers and a vibrant atmosphere!  
Please outline any relevant experience you may have as well as why you are interested in joining our team in your response to this posting.

Some Details:

* Extended Benefits Package after 3 months
* RRSP package for long\-term employees
* Wage to be negotiated based on experience.
* Paid vacation days

Please respond to this posting with your resume attached.

Salary Range: $50,000 – $67,500 annually, commensurate with experience.  
We also offer opportunities for career growth as we continue to expand our clinics and IT capabilities.

\*\*Due to the busy nature of the clinic, only successful candidates will be contacted\*\*

Benefits:

* Dental care
* Extended health care
* RRSP match

**Reports To:** Director, IT  



**Location:**  

 Vancouver, BC (On\-Site)  



  

**Primary Purpose**

The primary purpose of the Technical Support Analyst Tier (2\) is to support the UCW IT Team in ensuring high availability access to network resources for staff, students, and faculty. To fulfill this role effectively, the incumbent must possess a strong technical understanding of IT systems and support tools provided by IT. This includes the ability to work independently, research technology solutions, conduct testing, diagnose hardware and software issues, and be familiar with the Help Desk ticketing environment.


Additionally, the Technical Support Analyst Tier (2\) provides guidance, direction, and support to maximize the performance of staff and students. This involves offering assistance and expertise to help resolve technical issues promptly, as well as providing advice on best practices and optimal utilization of IT resources. Overall, the Technical Support Analyst Tier (2\) plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of IT systems and facilitating efficient access to network resources for all users within the organization.

* Providing application support for Papercut, Konica embedded devices, SCCM, Intune Enrollment Azure, and management.

jobs.title: IT Technician
jobs.description:
IT Technician – L1/L2

**Company:** ExcellIT  
**Location:** Brampton, ON  
**Work Setting:** Onsite at Client Location  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About ExcellIT

ExcellIT is seeking a reliable, hands\-on **IT Technician** to join our growing team. The successful candidate will work **onsite at one of our client locations in Brampton**, providing professional technical support directly to end users.

This is a client\-facing position requiring strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate more complex issues.

The Role

As an **L1/L2 IT Technician**, you will provide day\-to\-day technical support for the client's employees, systems, hardware, and software. You will be responsible for resolving issues efficiently, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring users receive a professional and positive IT support experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **Level 1 and Level 2 technical support** to onsite users
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues
* Troubleshoot Windows desktops, laptops, monitors, printers, and peripherals
* Install, configure, maintain, and deploy computers and other IT equipment
* Provide support for **Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and other business applications**
* Assist with user account creation, password resets, permissions, and access issues
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, printers, and basic network connectivity
* Perform workstation setups, upgrades, replacements, and device imaging
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding of employees
* Manage and update support tickets with accurate notes and resolutions
* Maintain IT asset and equipment documentation
* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior IT staff or external vendors when required
* Provide professional, courteous, and timely onsite customer service
* Assist with IT projects, deployments, and other technical tasks as required

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* **1–3\+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, or a similar role**
* Demonstrated **L1/L2 troubleshooting experience**
* Strong knowledge of **Windows 10/11**
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft 365**
* Experience troubleshooting computers, printers, peripherals, and common software issues
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals, including **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, and VPN**
* Familiarity with **Active Directory / Entra ID** is an asset
* Experience working with an IT ticketing system is an asset
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong customer service skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently in an onsite client environment
* Ability to prioritize multiple requests and manage competing deadlines

Assets

* CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Microsoft certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Intune
* Experience with Active Directory / Entra ID
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration
* Previous MSP or managed IT services experience
* Previous experience providing onsite client support

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **professional, dependable, personable, and technically capable**. You should enjoy helping people, be comfortable working directly with clients, and have the confidence to troubleshoot issues independently.

The successful candidate will represent **ExcellIT** directly at the client site, so professionalism, communication, and customer service are just as important as technical ability.

Work Location

**Brampton, Ontario – Onsite at Client Location**

This is an **onsite position** and requires the successful candidate to be comfortable working at the client's location on a daily basis.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed. Qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Pay: $50,000\.00\-$55,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**JOB TITLE: FIELD SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**REPORTING TO: REGIONAL SERVICE MANAGER**

**JOB PURPOSE**:

The Field Service Technician is a member of our CashTech Team responsible for equipment deployments, installation, and on\-going services. A Field Service Technician is a front\-line representative for CashTech and responsible to provide professional and courteous customer service with quality workmanship.

If you are a quality conscious team player, who cares about customer satisfaction, and enjoys troubleshooting to provide solutions, then you are a perfect fit for our team.

**Employee Responsibilities:**

* Represent CashTech in a professional manner while adhering to customer policies and procedures.
* Interacting with Customers while providing the highest level of service and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Responsible for first line maintenance of various equipment including but not limited to currency recyclers, drop safes, image scanners, printers, safe and Networked PC’s.
* Diagnose, repair, clean and adjust assemblies or subassemblies, restoring unit to functional standards.
* Adhere to escalation policies to ensure customer's SLA’s are met in a timely manner.
* Consistent, accurate, timely electronic service ticket maintenance.
* Ability to work without supervision.
* Work well in a team environment.
* Communicating with Customer Care Centre’s to relay job status upon completion of service calls.
* Identify business leads and promote growth for the company.
* Assist customers with operation and cleaning procedures.
* Manage trunk inventory with accuracy and complete periodic cycle counts.

**Qualifications Required:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required. Post\-secondary degree or certificate preferred.
* Minimum of 1 year experience in assembly and/or repair of electro\-mechanical components including AC and DC voltages and networked computers.
* Clean criminal record check (to be provided by applicant)
* Valid driver’s license, insured and licensed reliable vehicle is required.
* Must be able to work from detailed documentation and/or verbal and written instructions.
* Ability to stand, sit, kneel or bend for extended periods. May need to stand for several hours at a time.
* Ability to lift a maximum of 75 lbs. There is no lifting overhead however should be able to push upwards.
* Ability to use lift equipment, roll bars, and crowbars.
* Ability to use power tools including but not limited to drills, hammer drills. Minor soldering skills are required.
* Ability use of test equipment including digital multi meter.
* Ability to take standby and call outs on scheduled weekends.
* Comfortable with Microsoft office and cloud\-based computing programs.
* Ability to work in a mobile office setting

**Employee Expectations:**

* Use of the provided safety equipment and procedures to protect oneself and others.
* Maintain a professional appearance, both personally and in the work environment for customers and vendors.
* Present oneself in a positive and respectful manner toward co\-workers, customers and vendors.
* Communicate business issues immediately
* Perform daily record keeping and reporting
* Efficient use of time and materials in performing all tasks.
* Daily maintenance of tools, parts and work environment.
* Desire to continually learn and enhance one’s talents and expertise.
* Perform daily record keeping and reporting.
* Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work, including the public.
* Communicate (written and orally) effectively with both the customer and the company.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities, organize workload, and meet deadlines.

Job Type: Full\-time

* Dental care

* 75% (required)
