jobs.title: Level II Security Systems Technician
jobs.description:
**About New Age Group**  

For more than 25 years, **The New Age Group** has delivered security and technology solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and multi\-residential clients. Our expertise includes access control, video surveillance, intrusion alarms, ULC inspections, structured cabling, fiber optics, intercom systems, networking, and integrated technology platforms. We are committed to delivering high\-quality workmanship, innovative solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. Our technicians work with leading manufacturers and technologies while benefiting from ongoing training, certification programs, and clearly defined career progression opportunities.  

  

**Position Summary**  

The **Level II** **Technician** serves as a technical leader within the organization and is responsible for advanced installations, commissioning, troubleshooting, inspections, quality assurance, customer training, and mentoring junior technicians.  

  

This role requires an experienced technician capable of leading complex projects, resolving advanced technical challenges, maintaining high\-quality workmanship, and ensuring all installations meet New Age standards, customer requirements, manufacturer specifications, and applicable industry regulations.  

Level II Technicians play a critical role in technician development, quality control, and customer satisfaction.  

  

**Primary Responsibilities**  

**Technical Leadership*** Provide technical support to field technicians.
* Assist with project planning and execution.
* Mentor Apprentices, Labourers, Technician I, and Technician II personnel.
* Review installation quality and workmanship.
* Support commissioning and technical escalations.
* Assist with manufacturer training initiatives.

  

**Advanced Security Systems**  

**Intrusion Systems*** Advanced troubleshooting of intrusion alarm systems.
* Commission complex alarm installations.
* Resolve communication failures.
* Conduct ULC\-related inspections and testing.
* Support monitoring integrations.

**Access Control Systems*** Configure and commission complex access control systems.
* Troubleshoot controllers, readers, and field devices.
* Support enterprise\-level deployments.
* Verify system performance and functionality.
* Conduct quality assurance inspections.

**Surveillance Systems*** Configure and commission advanced IP surveillance systems.
* Troubleshoot networked video systems.
* Optimize camera layouts and performance.
* Conduct surveillance system audits.
* Verify recording retention and performance standards.

**Fiber Optics**  

Senior Technicians must be capable of:* Fiber troubleshooting
* Fiber certification
* Fiber commissioning
* OTDR testing
* Interpreting OTDR results
* Diagnosing communication failures
* Documenting fiber deficiencies

**System Commissioning*** Commission newly installed systems.
* Verify programming.
* Verify customer requirements are met.
* Conduct acceptance testing.
* Perform final system verification.
* Resolve deficiencies prior to customer onboarding.

**Quality Assurance**  

Senior Technicians are responsible for:* QA inspections
* Workmanship reviews
* Installation audits
* SOP verification
* Deficiency identification
* Corrective action recommendations


The Level II Technician acts as a quality gatekeeper before customer acceptance.  

  

**Customer Training**  

Provide customer training on:* Access Control Systems
* Video Surveillance Systems
* Intrusion Alarm Systems
* Mobile Applications
* User Management
* Basic Troubleshooting
* System Reporting Functions

**Documentation**  

Review and complete:* Service Reports
* Inspection Reports
* Commissioning Reports
* Certification Reports
* Deficiency Reports
* As\-Built Documentation
* Customer Turnover Documentation

**Required Qualifications**  

**Experience*** Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience
* Commercial security systems experience
* Access control experience
* Video surveillance experience
* Structured cabling experience
* Fiber optic experience
* Advanced troubleshooting experience

**Technical Requirements**  

Level II Technicians are expected to demonstrate competency in:* OTDR Testing
* Fiber Certification
* System Commissioning
* Complex Access Control Systems
* Enterprise Surveillance Systems
* Quality Assurance Inspections
* Customer Training
* Project Coordination
* Technical Escalation Support
* Advanced Troubleshooting


These competencies align with New Age's Level II Technician certification requirements.  

  

**Preferred Manufacturer Experience**  

Experience with:* ICT
* Axis Communications
* Milestone XProtect
* CDVI
* Mircom
* DoorGuard
* UniFi Networking

**Required Certifications*** Working at Heights
* WHMIS
* Aerial Lift Certification (Scissor Lift)
* Aerial Lift Certification (Boom Lift)
* Valid Ontario Driver's License

**Preferred Certifications*** ULC Intrusion Certification
* ULC Protective Signalling Systems
* ATC Certification
* ICT Certification
* Axis Certification
* Milestone Certification
* Fiber Certification
* Manufacturer Technical Certifications

**Leadership Responsibilities**  

The Level II Technician is expected to:* Mentor junior staff.
* Verify field workmanship.
* Review technician documentation.
* Assist with technician evaluations.
* Support technician development plans.
* Promote safety and quality standards.

**Safety Responsibilities*** Enforce New Age Health \& Safety policies.
* Conduct Job Hazard Assessments.
* Maintain safe work practices.
* Lead by example.
* Ensure PPE compliance.
* Verify safe use of ladders and aerial lifts.
* Report and correct unsafe conditions.

**Quality Standards**  

Level II Technicians are expected to enforce all New Age installation standards.  

**Zero\-Tolerance Zip Tie Policy**  

Zip ties are not permitted on structured cabling installations.  

Approved methods include:* Velcro Straps
* J\-Hooks

### **Job Title**


Cybersecurity Analyst – Tier 2### **Job Description**


The Security Operations Center – Tier 2 Analyst will lead complex investigations, coordinate incident response efforts, and drive continuous improvement in threat detection and response capabilities. You will serve as a technical expert and escalation point for Tier 1 analysts, customers or other departments. This role supports incident detection, escalation, and response activities within customer environments, in line with agreed SOC service scope and service level agreements (SLAs). You will have had previous experience in handling escalation from Tier 1 and direct work in security monitoring, threat intelligence, or incident response

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Perform advanced analysis of escalated security incidents and support investigation efforts.
* Act as an escalation point for Tier 1 analysts and provide expert guidance during incident response activities.
* Develop and tune detection rules and use cases in SIEM and other platforms.
* Perform threat hunting based on intelligence and behavioral analysis.
* Conduct forensic analysis and reverse engineering of malware when needed.
* Collaborate with threat intelligence teams to enrich investigations.
* Provide strategic recommendations to improve SOC processes and technologies.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to training programs.
* Participate in detection validation and lessons‑learned activities to enhance SOC detection and response.

**Additional Responsibilities**

**Monitoring \& Detection**

* Validate complex alerts escalated by Tier 1
* Determine scope, impact, and severity of confirmed incidents.
* Perform deep log analysis, forensic investigations, and develop custom detection rules.
* Implement containment, mitigation and remediation actions.in accordance with playbooks and customer agreements
* Understanding TTPs (tactics, techniques, procedures) of threat actors
* Ability to develop custom detection rules and correlation logic

**Investigation \& Analysis**

* Analyze data patterns and outliers to identify threat actor behaviors and insider threats.
* Conduct deep investigations into logs, network telemetry, and endpoint activity.
* Document findings, actions taken, and recommended next steps.

**Incident Response Support**

* Assist the SOC team during active security incidents by collecting evidence and containing low‑severity threats as per playbooks.
* Follow established runbooks to ensure consistent and compliant response actions.
* Respond to escalated security incidents requiring advanced analysis.
* Provide containment recommendations and support remediation.

**Access Management**

* Processing user access requests (add, remove, modify) following established workflows.
* Enforcing least‑privilege principles and role‑based access standards.
* Conducting periodic access reviews (user accounts, permissions, group memberships).
* Investigating and escalating suspicious access activities or unauthorized access attempts.

 **Patch Management**

* Assist with tracking and verifying system patch status as part of vulnerability review activities.
* Monitor patch‑related alerts (failed deployments, outdated versions) within security tools and coordinate remediation with IT operations.
* Support the vulnerability management process by validating missing patches identified during scans and escalating high‑risk findings.  

(This is aligned with Tier 1’s documented tasks involving vulnerability scans and reporting.)

**Reporting \& Communication**

* Generate clear, accurate incident reports and daily shift summaries.
* Communicate event details with internal teams in a professional and timely manner.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Recommend improvements to detection rules, response processes, and SOC procedures.
* Stay current on cyber threat trends, attacker techniques (TTPs), and security best practices.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years in a SOC or IR role.
* Advanced expertise in SIEM, EDR, and forensic tools.
* Strong understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK framework and threat actor TTPs.
* Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell).
* Ability to lead and manage incident response efforts under pressure.
* Relevant security certifications from ISC2 or ISACA
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or CS
* Certifications such as:
* CompTIA Security\+
* Microsoft SC\-200
* CEH, CySA\+
* GIAC certifications (GSEC, GCIH, GMON)
* Experience with:
* EDR, IDS/IPS, and network security tools
* SIEM/SOAR workflows/playbooks
* Threat intelligence platforms

 **Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
* Attention to detail
* Ability to work under pressure during incidents
* Team‑first mindset and willingness to learn
* Ability to recognize patterns and anomalies
* Prior SOC or IR experience
* Strong analysis and investigation skills
* Familiarity with threat intelligence and adversary behavior
* Ability to perform forensic/log analysis
* More advanced certifications preferred

 **Work Environment**

* 24/7 SOC environment \- day shift with weekend coverage
* Fast‑paced operational setting with tight response timelines
* Collaboration with cross‑functional IT and security teams

 **Salary range:**


This is a full\-time, exempt position, eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. The salary range listed represents the maximum and minimum starting base pay for this position as of the time of posting. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.


Salary range for this position is CAD$90,000 to CAD$115,000\.

jobs.title: Field Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  

As a Field Support Engineer, you will make an impact by providing onsite and remote support for end\-user devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and workplace technology services. You will support incident resolution, endpoint lifecycle management, and field service activities while ensuring a high\-quality user experience and adherence to service level agreements. You will be a valued member of the Cloud Infrastructure and Security team, working collaboratively with infrastructure, operations, and service management teams.

**In this role, you will**

* Provide onsite and remote support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, docking stations, and peripherals.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and Office Suite.
* Assist users with VPN, Wi\-Fi, MFA, and access\-related issues.
* Respond to incidents and service requests within agreed SLA timelines.
* Perform ticket triage, diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution activities.
* Escalate unresolved issues to specialized support teams with complete troubleshooting details.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation and user communication throughout the ticket lifecycle.
* Provide deskside support requiring physical intervention at office locations.
* Coordinate asset replacements, hardware repairs, warranty claims, and vendor visits.
* Support workstation deployments, office relocations, conference room technologies, and site\-specific IT activities.
* Act as a customer\-facing point of contact for onsite technical support.
* Perform device imaging, deployment, refresh, and decommissioning activities.
* Install, configure, and upgrade operating systems and applications.
* Maintain asset inventory and CMDB accuracy.
* Support laptop provisioning and endpoint deployment activities.

**Work model**  

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Toronto, ON.

*The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.*

**What you need to have to be considered**

* 5\+ years of experience providing desktop, deskside, or field services support in an enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting Windows operating systems, desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
* Hands\-on experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and Office Suite.
* Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, networking, and end\-user access issues.
* Experience working with ticketing systems in an SLA\-driven support environment.
* Knowledge of VPN, Wi\-Fi, MFA, and identity/access support.
* Experience with device imaging, deployment, refresh, and endpoint lifecycle management.
* Strong customer service, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

**These will help you stand out**

* Experience supporting executive users and customer\-facing environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* Experience with conference room and collaboration technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, or endpoint management solutions.
* Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, or end\-user computing certifications.


We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

**Total compensation**  

We regularly assess market data to ensure we offer a competitive compensation package for our associates. The base salary for this position ranges between $77,500\.00 – 90,000\.00 per year. Where the successful candidate may fall within the range depends on relevant education, work and/or management experience and other business\-related and job\-necessary qualifications. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual performance\-based bonus, as well as benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing.

jobs.title: Service Desk Administrator 1
jobs.description:
**SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR \- LEVEL 1**  

**MANAGED SERVICES \| TECHNICAL SUPPORT**  

**Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada**


Convergence Networks is one of North America’s leading managed service and managed security providers. We are a service company focused on helping clients leverage technology as a strategic tool and proactively protecting their business. We are fueled by providing outstanding service and sharing our passion for innovative technology as part of our integrated solutions.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Service Desk Administrator (SDA) is responsible for providing excellent customer experience by responding to and resolving incoming IT requests and alerts from our customers over the phone, through email, and in person. You will work on a variety of technical issues, from diagnosing network, server, and workstation problems, to thinking outside of the box to troubleshoot solutions and resolving complex problems.


This job operates at a very fast pace, and you must be comfortable handling high volumes of request tickets and phone calls. This position is similar to a Help Desk Analyst, Tier 1 Help Desk or Junior Network Administrator and offers many opportunities to advance within Convergence.

**WHAT WILL YOU DO AS A SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR?**

* Answer a high\-volume of inbound phone calls and emails from clients and perform initial troubleshooting on help desk tickets.
* Resolve customer tickets on the first contact, but also be able to determine when issue scope requires that a ticket be escalated to a System or Network Administrator or other support resource.
* Maintain accurate records on communication, resolution, assistance needed and follow\-up.
* Ensure customer satisfaction with service, communication and issue resolution.
* Other relevant job duties as assigned.

**WHAT SKILLS DO I NEED TO BE A SUCCESSFUL SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR?**

* Empathy, patience, and willingness to learn
* IT background with a focus on network support, implementation, and remote as well as onsite support.
* Familiarity with Active Directory and MS 365 Portal
* Understanding of networking
* Familiarity with Group Policy
* Technical prowess
* Documenting
* Familiarity with a ticketing and RMM system
* Familiarity with Event Viewer (checking for errors, reviewing logs)
* Familiarity with Windows OS and common applications
* Experience with administering current Windows desktop operating systems, Windows server operating systems, Exchange, Office 365, and a variety of backup solutions, routers, firewalls, and virtual/cloud\-based technologies.
* Experience using a triaging or priority system to gauge client issues and impact.
* Apple OSX and iOS experience.
* Ability to work effectively within a team as well as independently.
* Understanding of managed services and the value offered over a typical break\-fix environment.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written)
* Skilled at defusing high\-stress situations and facilitating resolution to technical problems.
* Willingness to learn, adjust, and grow with our company.
* Self\-starter with a positive attitude.

**WHAT QUALIFICATIONS DO I NEED TO HAVE?**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of relevant experience which may include Service Desk Support Specialist, Help Desk Technician, Help Desk Analyst, or Tier 2 (or similar) in a tiered environment.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills with IT and related hardware and software components (PCs, laptops, servers, firewalls, switches, routers, hard drives, Windows operating systems, etc.).
* Previous experience providing both onsite and remote/phone support in a fast paced, high volume environment.

**WHAT QUALIFICATIONS WOULD REALLY HELP SET ME APART FROM OTHER APPLICANTS?**

* Associate’s degree/College diploma or higher in Information Technology.
* Understanding of, and a background in working within the IT managed services provider business model, particularly in an IT support role.
* Experience with ConnectWise, Kaseya, or other similar MSP tools and software.
* Knowledge and experience working with Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Azure and other Cloud service offerings.

**WHAT IS THE WORK ENVIRONMENT LIKE?**

* Normal office working conditions. Work requires regular sitting/standing at a desk, working with a computer. This position requires standing, walking, sitting, using hands, seeing, reaching, talking, writing, and hearing; it may require occasionally carrying or lifting equipment (10\-50 pounds) if working on\-site.
* Position may require hours that exceed normal working hours per day during peak periods; on\-call or travel work may include nights or weekends
* Position requires regular contact with others \- in meetings, by phone or by email.
* Interactions focus on data collection, problem solving, needs analysis and technical training development. Interactions are initiated in person or electronically.
* Position may require some travel to Convergence or client sites.

**WHY SHOULD YOU WORK HERE?**

* Culture of unity, transparency, and trust. Our leadership team wants you to be successful at Convergence, and we will do anything we can to support your personal and professional growth.
* Group benefits plans including medical, dental, vision, and 401k.
* Education and certification reimbursement is also available so we can help you grow.
* We believe feedback makes us better. You can expect regular meetings with your manager and quarterly conversations about your performance and growth.
* Outstanding teammates. We’re very selective to make sure we have the best staff available for you to work alongside!
* Many teambuilding and company events throughout the year so you can get to know your teammates on a more personal level, as well as kick back and have some fun (families are oftentimes included as well).

**PERFECT FIT…**


If this sounds like your type of place and you can wow us with your spectacular skill set, then we would love to hear from you!


We are an eq

jobs.title: Junior Field Technician-BC M/F
jobs.description:
Overview  

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Field Technician to join our technical support team. The Junior Field Technician is the foundational support mechanism for our site operations. This role requires a hands\-on, mechanically inclined individual who thrives in a fast\-paced construction environment. The successful candidate will act as the right hand to our senior technicians, ensuring equipment is prepped, safety protocols are strictly followed, and fundamental installation and monitoring tasks are executed with precision.

 **Responsibilities**  

Field Operations \& Technical Support  

Provide direct labor and operational support for the installation of civil and geotechnical instrumentation (e.g., drilling, mixing concrete/postcrete, mounting protective enclosures).  

Perform basic hand\-tool and power\-tool operations, including fitting mechanical fixings and concrete anchors.  

Conduct basic manual data collection using handheld readouts (e.g., inclinometers, water level meters, VW/digital readouts).  

Assist in geomatics tasks, including acting as a surveyor’s assistant and leveling AMTS (Automated Motorized Total Station) equipment.  

Perform basic electrical tasks, such as stripping wires and executing correct cable terminations.  

Ensure meticulous photographic documentation of all pre\- and post\-work conditions.

 **Equipment Stewardship \& Logistics**  

Prepare, load, and mobilize tools and specialized equipment for daily site deployment.  

Take absolute ownership of toolkits and shared equipment. Thoroughly clean, organize, and properly store gear at the end of every shift to ensure operational readiness for the next day.  

Proactively report any missing, damaged, or uncalibrated equipment immediately.  

Label and safely quarantine decommissioned or retrieved sensors for the Workshop Manager.  

Conduct and document daily vehicle inspections for company fleet assets prior to operation.

 **Health, Safety \& Compliance**  

Participate actively in daily Field Level Hazard Assessments (FLHA) and Toolbox Safety Talks.  

Adhere strictly to all site\-specific safety requirements and Sixense H\&S policies.  

Maintain a clean, clutter\-free workspace, both on active construction sites and within the company workshop.

 **Qualifications/Skills**  

Highly punctual and organized individual  

Team player and accountable  

Physical Capability: Must be capable of safely lifting, carrying, and manipulating equipment weighing up to 50 lbs (23 kg) independently.  

Working Conditions: Must be able to perform sustained physical labor outdoors in variable B.C. weather conditions (heat, cold, rain, snow) and navigate uneven, active construction site terrain safely.  

Driver’s License \& Travel: Requires a valid B.C. class 5 license with a clean driving abstract to operate company fleet vehicles.  

Safety Certifications: Working at Heights and Confined Space Entry are highly preferred. Employment and site deployment are contingent upon the successful completion of these mandatory training modules


Sixense, a subsidiary of VINCI Construction, is a leading player in the fields of infrastructure and construction project monitoring, engineering, and digitalization. Through its expertise in instrumentation, data analytics, consulting, and infrastructure lifecycle management, Sixense supports its clients at every stage of an asset's lifecycle, from design and construction to operation and maintenance.Present in 20 countries, Sixense relies on a network of local offices and international subsidiaries to help monitor infrastructure, enhance construction site safety, and optimize asset maintenance. Today, the Group brings together more than 840 employees and generated revenue of €124 million in 2025\.

jobs.title: Computer Systems Analyst (Tier 2 Technician)
jobs.description:
**General Summary**

The Computer Systems Analyst is responsible for handling a wide range of technical support requests and service tickets—typically of higher complexity than first\-level support. This includes troubleshooting and resolving issues across workstations, servers, printers, networks, and vendor\-specific hardware and software.

This role is best suited for a mature, client\-facing IT professional who is confident working directly with both technical and non\-technical users. A successful CSA brings strong communication skills, professionalism, and a calm, reassuring presence to client interactions. Whether working independently or as part of a team, this person excels at solving problems and making clients feel supported and understood.

The ideal candidate takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and approaches challenges with a service\-first mindset. They are comfortable working independently or collaboratively, and most importantly, they create positive client experiences by making users feel heard, supported and valued.

**Primary Responsibilities**

· Provide professional, client\-focused technical support while demonstrating strong communication, active listening, and customer service skills

· Act as a trusted point of contact for a designated subset of clients—developing deep familiarity with their environments and becoming a subject matter expert to support and advocate on their behalf

· Take ownership of higher\-level technical requests and work collaboratively with internal teams to drive issues to resolution

· Prepare and deploy workstations for clients—including imaging, configuration, software installation, documentation, and on\-site or remote support

· Participate in and support new client onboarding processes—assisting with initial hardware and service configuration, environment documentation, and knowledge sharing

· Utilize Skycomp’s core toolset (e.g., backup solutions, endpoint protection, monitoring, cloud services, and security platforms) to maintain client environments

· Configure, support, and troubleshoot network infrastructure including servers, switches, firewalls, and printers

· Perform Active Directory administration (adds, changes, removals), manage cloud services, and support common business applications

· Contribute to Skycomp’s layered security initiatives through configuration, monitoring, and audit support

· Maintain detailed and accurate documentation within internal systems

· Mentor junior team members and provide guidance as needed to support skill development

· Attend internal meetings, share insights with peers, and engage in continuous learning and knowledge exchange

**Expected Results**

Through proper execution of the above responsibilities, Computer Systems Analysts will deliver an exceptional support experience, maintain strong client relationships, and grow technically through exposure to real\-world challenges.

The right CSA for this role is dependable, confident, and people\-first. They balance technical skill with emotional intelligence and are not afraid to lead conversations, manage client expectations, and advocate for both the user and the technology.

**Credentials and Experience** 

· Post\-secondary education in a related field (e.g., Computer Systems Technology or equivalent experience)

· 2\+ years of professional experience working in or alongside an IT environment—this could include help desk, internal IT, MSP, or other technical roles

· Maturity, professionalism, and confidence in an office environment—comfortable speaking with a wide range of users across different industries, from front\-line staff to executive leadership

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills—able to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and maintain a high level of customer service

· Experience with any of the following is considered an asset:

* Cisco switching and networking
* Backup and disaster recovery platforms
* Antivirus and security tools
* VPN setup and troubleshooting
* RMM tools, ticketing systems, and scripting

· Valid Ontario G\-class driver’s license and access to reliable transportation is a must

· Physically capable of deploying and moving IT equipment such as workstations, servers, and networking gear at client sites

**Why Choose Skycomp?**

jobs.title: Junior IT Infrastructure Technician
jobs.description:
**About Sync**  

Sync is a Canadian company building zero\-knowledge, end\-to\-end encrypted cloud storage and collaboration for over two million people and businesses worldwide. Unlike most of our competitors, we own and operate our own storage infrastructure rather than renting it. Our customers’ data lives on our hardware, in our racks, in Canada. That is a core part of our product promise, and it means the physical infrastructure is not a back\-office concern here. It is the product.  

  

**About the role**  

We are hiring a Junior IT Infrastructure Technician to help maintain the JBODs, servers, and network gear in our Toronto colocation facility. This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, with regular travel to our Toronto Data Centre required to do hands\-on work, and a genuinely strong entry point into storage and infrastructure engineering, you will be working directly on petabyte\-scale storage systems from your first week.  

  

You will rack and maintain hardware, replace failed drives and components, own the RMA process end to end, manage procurement, and support the day\-to\-day IT needs of the team. We are looking for someone early in their career who is curious about how things work and who moves toward problems instead of waiting to be assigned them. You will not be expected to arrive knowing everything. You will be expected to ask good questions, document what you learn, and take real ownership of the things you touch. Once you're ramped up, this role will also include participation in an on\-call rotation.  

  

**What you will do*** Maintain our JBOD storage enclosures: identify and replace failed drives, verify rebuilds complete cleanly, and track drive health and failure trends over time.
* Install, cable, configure, provision and decommission servers and storage chassis in our Toronto colocation cage.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware faults across drives, memory, PSUs, HBAs, SAS expanders, backplanes, and network components.
* Support network infrastructure: rack and cable switches, maintain accurate port maps, and assist with configuration changes under supervision.
* Support the team during critical situations: respond to monitoring alerts, work the relevant runbook, and help recover systems from unexpected failures.
* Own the RMA process end to end: identify the failure, open the case with the vendor, track the shipment, install the replacement, and confirm the fix. Then make sure the inventory reflects reality.
* Manage procurement for hardware and IT equipment, including quoting, purchase orders, receiving, and day\-to\-day vendor communication.
* Maintain an accurate asset inventory covering serial numbers, warranty status, rack and slot locations, and lifecycle state.
* Keep the cage clean and auditable through disciplined structured cabling, labelling, and cable management.
* Handle media sanitization and secure disposal of decommissioned drives in line with our security policies.
* Coordinate with the colocation provider on remote hands, access approvals, power and cooling questions, and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Provide general IT support to internal staff, including laptop provisioning, account setup, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Write and improve runbooks so the next person can do the task without having to ask.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents after an onboarding period.

**What we are looking for*** 0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, datacenter operations, or a related hands\-on technical role. Co\-op terms, internships, home labs, and personal projects all count.
* A proactive mindset. You notice the drive that keeps throwing errors before it fails outright, and you raise it.
* Real curiosity about infrastructure. You want to understand why a system behaves the way it does, not just which button restarts it.
* Working knowledge of server and storage hardware, and comfort using hand tools in a rack environment.
* Linux fundamentals at the command line: navigating the filesystem, reading logs with journalctl and dmesg, and using basic disk and filesystem tooling such as lsblk, smartctl and df.
* Basic networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLANs, switching, subnetting, routing and the ability to read and maintain a cable map.
* Care and precision around data. In a live storage environment, pulling the wrong drive matters — we need someone who checks twice before executing any task.
* Clear written communication. A significant part of this job is leaving a good record for the next person.
* Strong organizational habits, particularly around tracking assets, tickets, and open vendor cases.
* Ability to work on\-site in Toronto and to lift and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Eligibility to work in Canada.

**Nice to have*** Exposure to a colocation or datacenter environment.
* Familiarity with SAS or SATA storage topologies, RAID or erasure coding concepts, or distributed storage systems such as ZFS or Ceph.
* Scripting in Bash or Python to automate repetitive work such as drive health checks or inventory reconciliation.
* Experience with out\-of\-band management tools such as iDRAC, iLO, or IPMI.
* Any exposure to a switch CLI – Cisco NX\-OS or IOS, HP ProCurve, or similar –even if only show commands.
* Any exposure to monitoring and alerting tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix.
* Familiarity with Containers (Docker, LXC) or with a directory and identity service for user and device management.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Server\+, or equivalent coursework.

**Perks:*** Compensation range: $50,000 to $58,000 CAD
* Generous WSA program
* Best\-in\-the\-class health benefits
* Paid vacation with carry\-over
* Flexible Hybrid
* Direct hands\-on experience with petabyte\-scale storage infrastructure that very few companies our size operate themselves.
* A clear growth path toward storage, systems, or network engineering, with mentorship from the senior staff who built this infrastruct

**Job Posting**

 **Tier 1 NOC Technician**

 **Who We Are**


We are a fast\-growing and forward\-thinking company that owns, manages and operates extensive fibre\-optic networks, and has been offering the ultimate in connectivity since 2014\. Focused on expanding coverage in regions of central and western Canada, we’re bringing more choice and better service to businesses and the people who live there.

  

Everyone at FlexNetworks is committed to customer loyalty and to earn and retain our customer’s trust by delivering exceptional service and exceeding expectations. We are a communicative and collaborative team who work together towards our shared goals. FlexNetworks puts People First. We do this by fostering an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive!




The Tier 1 Network Operations Centre (NOC) Technician is responsible for the aggregation of trouble tickets across the disparate ticketing systems and outsourced, third\-party NOC entities that are engaged for FlexNetworks’ Business, Residential, and MDU lines of business. This role provides daily operational oversight to perform trouble ticket triage and resolution, ticket escalation, timely customer and internal communications, while ensuring strict adherence to SLA objectives.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **NOC Governance \& Quality Oversight**

  

* Perform triage between Network, Field Operations, and Customer Experience.
* Conduct reviews of all tickets handled to verify runbook compliance, SLA adherence, escalation completion, and communication quality.
* Monitor open tickets throughout the day for overdue updates, escalation needs, and documentation of next steps.
* Define and communicate areas where the NOCs can improve upon on ticket quality, classification accuracy, and communication standards.
* Ensure ticket queues maintain clarity, accuracy, and completeness of customer and technical information.

 **Ticket Ownership \& Assignment Integrity**

  

* Review and ensure assignment of all unassigned or misrouted tickets across all customer segments (Business, Residential, MDU).
* Validate that each ticket has a clear owner, correct severity category, and documented next action.
* Coordinate with the and Call Centre to ensure they have the information, context, and guidance needed to independently assess whether an issue is network\-related or requires field operations.
* Oversee ticket flow for all customer segments, ensuring proper escalation and handling without unnecessary handoffs.

 **SLA, Escalation \& Communication Discipline**

  

* Monitor SLA objectives for updates and restoration across Business and Residential services, including MDU.
* Intervene when SLA breaches or communication gaps occur, ensuring to escalate issues appropriately.
* Adhere to escalation time scales as set out within the FlexNetworks Customer Support and Escalation Policy
* Ensure customers receive timely, accurate updates directly from NOC without requiring Field Ops or Network teams to manage communication loops.
* Escalate unresolved SLA or coordination issues
* Review, draft, and improve Customer\-Facing communication standards to ensure they reflect operational realities and customer expectations.

 **Service Assurance \& Incident Management**

  

* Lead post\-incident reviews and create clear, customer\-ready RFO (Reason for Outage) documents.
* Analyze trends in service incidents; identify process or network improvements and escalate recommendations to appropriate teams.
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, and service assurance processes to ensure alignment across NOC, Call Centre, Network, and Field Operations teams.

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

  

* Work closely with Network, Field Operations, Customer Experience, and external NOC partners to ensure clarity of roles and escalation pathways.
* Serve as the operational point of contact for ticket\-quality questions and process improvements.
* Ensure internal process alignment, perform runbook updates, and Network/Field Ops coordination.
* Streamline workflows to improve reliability and customer satisfaction outcomes.

 **Key Traits, Qualifications \& Experience**

  

* Fundamental knowledge of networking; CCNA or similar certification is an asset.
* Experience in NOC or ISP Call\-Centre or support roles.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage ticket flows and ensure process adherence.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence teams without direct reporting authority.

 **Work Conditions**

  

* Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM, with the expectation of morning ticket reviews covering overnight activity and daytime oversight of escalations.
* Not part of a regular 24/7 technical on\-call rotation. After\-hours ticket management is handled by NOC and Call Centre teams operating to established runbooks; this role audits compliance upon return.
* Expected to monitor critical issues during business hours and intervene as needed.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Advatek Systems is a Maritime\-based systems integrator with a primary focus on Weigh Scale technology and Automatic Identification and Data Capture (AIDC) systems. Since 1987, Advatek Systems has been based out of Moncton, NB while supporting a customer base across the Maritime provinces. We provide the right mix of equipment, software, technical services, and the expertise to craft a tailored solution to fulfill industry\-specific business requirements. Advatek has been a key partner to many of Atlantic Canada’s industry leaders in manufacturing, food production, lumber, aqua\-farming, municipal and provincial governments as well as healthcare.

We are currently seeking a **Junior Scale Technician** to join our team out of our Dieppe, NB office. This is an entry\-level role designed for someone with an electronics, electrical, or mechanical trade background who is ready to learn the specialized world of weigh scale technology. Working alongside experienced technicians, you will learn to install, service, troubleshoot, and calibrate weighing equipment used across the Maritimes. Through a structured 12\-week onboarding program you will work toward your first Measurement Canada accreditation, then continue building your skills and earning additional accreditations (with pay increases tied to each) over your first one to three years. **This is a permanent, full\-time position reporting to the Operations Manager.**

**Duties and Responsibilities** 

* Complete a structured 12\-week onboarding program covering safety, scale components and terminology, calibration, and legal\-for\-trade requirements
* Assemble, install, set up, and calibrate bench and floor scales in the shop and at customer sites, initially under the guidance and sign\-off of a senior technician
* Service, troubleshoot, and repair weighing equipment (load cells, indicators, junction boxes, and associated wiring), diagnosing both electrical and mechanical faults
* Prepare scales for Measurement Canada inspection and accurately complete calibration certificates, test weight correlation forms, and product test sheets
* Achieve Measurement Canada accreditation for bench and floor scales (MC 3\-10\) within the first three months
* Shadow and assist senior technicians on truck scale, industrial, and systems service calls and installation projects
* Progress to solo service calls (calibration checks, diagnostics, and routine maintenance) as skills and accreditations are signed off
* Install and support label printers and related data capture systems
* Communicate with customers in a professional manner about the work performed and system functions
* Complete all daily, weekly, and monthly paperwork, service reports, and documentation as required
* Understand, adhere to, and promote environmental health \& safety practices
* Keep company vehicle, tools, and equipment organized and well maintained
* All other duties as assigned by management

**Training and Career Progression**

* **Months 1–3 (Probation):** safety and forklift training, bench and floor scale calibration, legal\-for\-trade process, field shadowing
* **First accreditation:** MC 3\-10 exam and practical, then rostered for legal\-for\-trade work
* **Years 1–3:** self\-paced advancement through additional Measurement Canada accreditations as job opportunities allow, including:
* Retail and computing scales (counter, POS, prepack)
* Industrial systems (hopper, crane, and overhead rail)
* On\-board forklift weighing
* Truck scales (attended and unattended) and railway scales
* Mentorship throughout, and each accreditation tier earns a **permanent hourly pay increase**

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Diploma, certificate, or trade background in electronics, electrical, instrumentation, industrial mechanics (millwright), or a related technical field
* Trade work experience is an asset; recent graduates are encouraged to apply
* Working knowledge of basic electrical and electronic principles, including use of a multimeter and reading wiring diagrams
* Mechanical aptitude, strong manual dexterity, and comfort with hand and power tools
* Knowledge of low voltage industrial control systems considered an asset
* Outgoing, professional, and friendly personality with the ability to liaise with customers
* Organized, dependable, and computer\-literate, with a genuine willingness to learn
* Bilingual in French and English considered an asset but not required
* Weigh scale experience is not required; familiarity with these manufacturers is an asset: Mettler Toledo, Rice Lake, Weigh\-tronix

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Class 5 driver’s license and a clean driving record
* Willingness to obtain a Class 3 driver’s license as part of your career progression
* Achieve Measurement Canada MC 3\-10 accreditation within the 12\-week probationary period
* Comfortable with physical work, including lifting, bending, and working outdoors in all seasons
* Willingness to travel throughout the Maritimes, including occasional overnight stays
* Ability to pass a criminal record check and carry a government security clearance

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive starting wage with pay increases tied to each accreditation you earn
* Paid, hands\-on training and a clear one\-to\-three\-year certification path
* Company\-provided laptop and cell phone
* 50% employer paid comprehensive group benefits (health, dental, vision, insurance)
* Employee \& Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
* Paid travel and accommodation, including meal allowances as required
* Group Savings Plan (RRSP) with Company Matching (DPSP)

Pay: $18\.00\-$24\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 44\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Network Field Technician

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| British Columbia**  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Setting:** On\-site / Field\-based  
**Location:** Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.  
**Travel:** Regular travel between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.; occasional travel to other areas of Ontario may be required.

About Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. is a growing Managed Field Services Provider (MFSP) supporting MSPs, technology companies, enterprise IT teams, and multi\-location organizations.

We provide reliable onsite IT and infrastructure execution, acting as the field\-service execution layer between remote IT operations and physical customer locations.

Our services include:

* On\-site IT and technical support
* Network and connectivity installations
* Infrastructure deployments and technology rollouts
* Hardware and workstation deployments
* Structured cabling and physical network infrastructure
* Security and compliance\-related installations

Our work is performed using defined work orders, professional field procedures, structured documentation, and clear communication with remote IT teams and project managers.

As Viverlink expands its regional presence in the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC., we are building a professional field\-service network and are looking for technicians who can grow with the organization and take on increasingly complex assignments.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Network Field Technician** who is comfortable working independently at customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC. and can represent Viverlink professionally in the field.

This is a hands\-on role involving network equipment installation, troubleshooting, structured cabling, hardware deployment, and onsite technical support.

You will frequently work from detailed work orders and coordinate with remote engineers, MSP teams, project managers, and customer representatives.

The right candidate does not need to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting instincts, professional communication, and the ability to learn and grow.

Key ResponsibilitiesNetwork \& Infrastructure

* Install, replace, configure, and test network equipment such as switches, routers, wireless access points, and related hardware.
* Perform basic network connectivity troubleshooting using TCP/IP concepts and common diagnostic methods.
* Identify and troubleshoot physical network and infrastructure issues.
* Perform structured cabling activities, including cable routing, termination, labeling, patching, and basic testing.
* Install and organize network equipment in racks, cabinets, and customer environments.
* Assist with network upgrades, technology rollouts, hardware refreshes, and multi\-site deployments.
* Perform hardware replacement and equipment installation according to approved work instructions.

Field Service Execution

* Review work orders and site requirements before arriving onsite.
* Arrive prepared with the required tools, information, and equipment.
* Follow client\-specific instructions, technical documentation, site procedures, and safety requirements.
* Work independently while maintaining communication with remote technical teams.
* Escalate issues when they exceed the assigned scope or technical authority.
* Avoid making unauthorized changes to customer environments.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate work\-order and ticket information.
* Document work performed, findings, configuration changes, serial numbers, and relevant observations.
* Capture required photographs and other completion evidence.
* Clearly communicate issues, blockers, and outstanding work.
* Complete professional field\-service reports following Viverlink and client requirements.

Customer Interaction

* Represent Viverlink professionally at customer locations.
* Communicate clearly with site contacts and customer personnel.
* Manage expectations and provide accurate status updates.
* Maintain a professional presence in offices, retail locations, technical facilities, and other customer environments.
* Protect customer information and follow applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

Required Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate practical ability in several of the following areas:

Networking

* Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking.
* Familiarity with switches, routers, wireless access points, and network cabling.
* Ability to perform basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand IP addressing, Ethernet, VLAN concepts, and common network terminology.

Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure

* Experience with structured cabling.
* Ability to terminate, label, organize, and test network cables.
* Familiarity with patch panels, racks, cable management, and physical network infrastructure.
* Ability to use basic field testing and hand tools.

Troubleshooting

* Ability to systematically identify the cause of technical problems.
* Comfortable troubleshooting connectivity, hardware, cabling, and physical infrastructure issues.
* Able to distinguish between issues that can be resolved onsite and those requiring escalation.

Field Service

* Comfortable working independently at customer sites.
* Able to follow work orders and technical instructions accurately.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Reliable and punctual.
* Comfortable travelling between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.

Communication

* Professional verbal and written communication.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical personnel.
* Able to provide concise and accurate field updates.

Assets / Preferred Qualifications

The following are considered assets but are **not mandatory**:

* CompTIA Network\+
*

jobs.title: Analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes
jobs.description:
**Lieu**
--------



Ottawa (Ontario)


**Rémunération prévue**
-----------------------



50 000 $ – 65 000 $


**Supérieur immédiat**
----------------------



Directeur, technologies de l’information et sécurité informatique


**Résumé**
----------



Le Parti libéral du Canada (PLC) est à la recherche d’un analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes pour travailler à la permanence nationale du parti à Ottawa. Il s’agit d’une occasion de se joindre à une équipe d’employés dévoués qui appuient Mark Carney et l’équipe libérale pour continuer de bâtir un Canada fort.



L’analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes est chargé de fournir un soutien technique aux employés et aux bénévoles partout au pays tout en contribuant à assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et l’efficacité de l’infrastructure de TI du parti.



Le candidat idéal est soucieux du service client, à l’écoute des autres et compétent sur le plan technique. Il s’épanouit dans un milieu collaboratif au rythme soutenu.


**Avantages offerts**
---------------------


* Couverture d’assurance complète
* Programmes de bien\-être
* Programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille
* Régime de retraite à cotisations déterminées
* Horaire de travail flexible
* Emplacement de choix au centre\-ville, à proximité des commerces et des transports en commun
* Adhésion sans frais à un centre de conditionnement physique et accès à des douches
* Casiers pour vélos

**Qualités recherchées**
------------------------


* Communication
* Capacité à résoudre des problèmes
* Bonne gestion du temps
* Responsabilisation
* Souci du détail
* Professionnalisme

**Responsabilités**
-------------------


* Fournir un soutien en TI de premier niveau aux employés qui travaillent partout au pays.
* Faciliter l’intégration et le départ des employés et des intervenants, notamment en termes de création de comptes, de mise en place de l’équipement et de gestion des accès.
* Déployer et maintenir les mises à jour du système d’exploitation et des applications pour veiller à ce que les systèmes demeurent sécurisés et bénéficient d’un soutien technique.
* Surveiller et maintenir l’infrastructure et les services d’infonuagique.
* Participer aux activités liées à la cybersécurité, notamment aux niveaux de la gestion des vulnérabilités, du programme de sensibilisation à la sécurité et de l’application des pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité.
* Créer et tenir à jour de la documentation sur les processus et les systèmes.
* Maintenir un inventaire exact des ressources de TI du PLC.
* Veiller à ce que les plans de reprise après sinistre informatique soient à jour et exécutables grâce à des tests réguliers et à une documentation adéquate.
* Surveiller les orientations et les pratiques exemplaires du secteur, ainsi que les technologies émergentes, pour recommander les améliorations continues à apporter à l’infrastructure de TI du PLC.
* Exécuter d’autres tâches, au besoin.

**Critères d’embauche**
-----------------------


* Minimum de deux années d’expérience dans le domaine du soutien technique dans un milieu de prestation de services au rythme soutenu et capacité éprouvée à résoudre un vaste éventail de problèmes techniques.
* Excellentes aptitudes en service à la clientèle, en communication et en résolution de problèmes, et capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques à des utilisateurs non initiés.
* Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à prioriser les tâches et à gérer des demandes multiples de manière efficace.
* Connaissance pratique de Microsoft Windows, de Microsoft 365 et de l’infonuagique hybride (comme Azure et AWS).
* Connaissance des fondements de la réseautique, des technologies d’accès à distance, des RPV, de la gestion de l’identité et de l’accès, de la gestion des terminaux, ainsi que de la sauvegarde et de la restauration des données.
* Connaissance pratique du langage SQL, notamment pour exécuter des requêtes de base et effectuer le dépannage des intégrations qui s’appuient sur des bases de données SQL.
* Des connaissances de base en rédaction de scripts ou en automatisation (PowerShell, par exemple) sont considérées comme un atout.
* Compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en cybersécurité, comme la gestion des correctifs, la gestion des vulnérabilités et les principes de sécurité infonuagique.
* Un baccalauréat ou un diplôme collégial dans un domaine technologique est un atout.
* Les certifications techniques comme AWS cloud Practitioner, Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Security\+ constituent des atouts.
* Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) constitue un atout.

**Postulez**
------------



Le PLC défend l’équité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous encourageons fortement les candidatures des groupes visés par l’équité en emploi, notamment les femmes, les Autochtones, les personnes racisées, les personnes 2ELGBTQI\+ et les personnes vivant avec un handicap. Si vous vous considérez comme membre d’un groupe visé par l’équité en emploi, vous pouvez l’indiquer dans votre formulaire de candidature.



Cette offre d’emploi concerne un poste vacant existant. Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt envers ce poste, mais nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les personnes retenues pour un entretien. Le Parti libéral du Canada n’utilise pas l’intelligence artificielle pour trier, évaluer ou sélectionner des candidats.



Le PLC souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et examinera toute demande d’accommodement s’appuyant sur une contre\-indication médicale, la religion ou tout autre motif de discrimination illicite en vertu des lois en vigueur en matière de droits de la personne.



Le PLC invite toutes les personnes qualifiées à poser leur candidature. Le PLC a un excellent bilan relatif au soutien aux personnes handicapées. Veuillez envoyer un courriel au service des ressources humaines (hr\-rh@liberal.ca) si, pendant le processus de soumission de candidature, vous avez besoin d’un accommodement particulier ou souhaite

You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring customer retention by effectively communicating service work timeline and expectations.  

  

The work model for the role is: \#LI\-onsite. (traveling role field service: 50% on surface, 50% underground)  

  

This role is contributing to the **Automation Process Industries, Mining and Materials in Sudbury, Ontario.**

* Deliver an exceptional customer experience by communicating clearly, demonstrating urgency, and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer operations, eliminate pain points, and communicate service growth opportunities to ABB account teams.
* Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues through remote and on\-site support for certified products and service offerings.
* Plan and prepare service activities by securing the required materials, parts, tools, and equipment to achieve a first\-time\-right outcome.
* Drive continuous improvement by recommending corrective and preventive actions, improving work processes, and preparing accurate service documentation and customer reports.
* Promote ABB's safety culture while collaborating with customers and colleagues, reporting hazards, mentoring junior technicians and engineers, providing technical guidance, and delivering training when required.

 **Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

* Demonstrated mechanical aptitude, problem\-solving skills, and ability to support complex industrial equipment in field environments.

Excellent English communication skills, with a valid driver’s license and passport, and willingness to travel extensively to customer sites (60\-70%). French is a strong asset.  
* 

**What’s in it for you?**

new_jobs.title: IT Support Technician
new_jobs.description:
### **About PixMob**


PixMob creates magical experiences for live events around the world ✨. You might have seen 60,000 fans light up at the Super Bowl or at a Coldplay concert. Our mission? To spark joy and unforgettable memories for every fan.


We work with international artists, event organizers, sports teams, and brands to make every event extra special. At PixMob, innovation and design are in our DNA. From rapid prototyping to mass manufacturing, we craft cutting\-edge wireless tech right at our Montreal HQ. And we care about the planet —we fight single\-use plastics and use recycled or compostable materials wherever we can.

**We’re looking for an IT Support Technician**

### **About the role**


We're looking for an IT Support Technician to join our team in Montreal. You'll be the first person our colleagues turn to when something isn't working, whether they're sitting next to you in the office or working remotely. The role is hands\-on: fixing problems, setting up laptops, keeping our inventory straight and making sure meeting rooms just work.


This is an entry\-level position. If you've recently finished a DEC, DEP or AEC in IT support and have some real\-world experience from an internship, a previous job or serious school projects, we'd like to hear from you. You'll learn a lot, and you'll have room to grow into more technical work over time.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* Handle first\-line support requests coming in through Jira, chat or people walking up to your desk
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues on **macOS** (about 90% of our fleet) and Windows (about 10%), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar) and everyday business apps
* Prepare, deploy and manage laptops through our MDM tools (Mosyle for Macs, NinjaOne for Windows)
* Run onboarding and offboarding: create and disable accounts, set up equipment, make sure new hires are ready on day one
* Keep the hardware inventory and asset tracking up to date (laptops, monitors, peripherals, accessories)
* Look after meeting rooms and AV equipment: screens, video conferencing, cabling, and quick fixes when a meeting is about to start
* Keep the office IT setup in good shape: desks, docking stations, monitors, cable management, and setting up or moving workstations when people join or change seats
* Document fixes and write short how\-to guides so people can help themselves
* Escalate to senior team members when needed, with clear notes on what you've already tried
* Basic network and printer troubleshooting

### **What we’re looking for**

* DEC, DEP or AEC in IT support, computer science or a related field
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience, internships and school projects count
* Comfortable supporting macOS users and Google Workspace; some Windows experience is a plus
* Bilingual, French and English, spoken and written (you'll support people in both languages every day)
* Good at explaining technical things to non\-technical people, patient, and calm when several requests land at once
* Organized, reliable, and able to keep track of tickets and inventory without being chased
* Able to be in the office regularly for walk\-in support and hardware work

**Nice to have**

* Experience with a ticketing system (Jira Service Management or similar)
* Familiarity with an MDM or RMM tool (Mosyle, NinjaOne, Jamf, Kandji)
* Exposure to Linux
* Basic networking knowledge (Wi\-Fi, DHCP, VPN)
* Experience with AV or video conferencing setups (Google Meet hardware, Zoom Rooms)

### **Languages \& Inclusivity**


You’ll need to be fluent in English (written \& spoken), as day\-to\-day work involves collaboration with international employees — US, Europe, Asia\-Pacific, and more.


Inclusivity is at the heart of our culture . We welcome and value candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our job posting uses simplified grammar to make it easier to read across languages and is not intended to exclude or favor any gender.


Join us to help build a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected and empowered ✨.

*Thanks for your interest in PixMob and this role! Only selected candidates will be contacted.*

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Bilingual IT Service Specialist, will work with a team in the Technical Helpdesk to provide first\-level technical support for Carquest Stores, Corporate and Distribution Center team members. Exploris and Weblink end users, applications and infrastructure; and perform technical support to keep all systems performing with minimum down time. The IT Service Specialist will work with internal and external customers to gather and verify information to accurately diagnose IT issues and troubleshoot to complete resolution.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Under general supervision, troubleshoot IT issues (identify probable cause with hard facts and data, investigate resolution, determine root cause, and demonstrate success of solution), by following instructions, learning from senior Analysts and Developers, and collaborating with other support teams.
* Escalate more complex problems to next level.
* Utilize software release documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQs to aid in problem resolution.
* Respond with urgency to system failure situations and provide collaborative solutions to other analysts, developers, engineers, and support teams.
* Clearly document problem resolution thoroughly in support tools for future reference and team member training.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bilingual English/French
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Experience using Microsoft Office Professional Series (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint and Outlook)
* Experience using incident management systems (such as Service Now), for incident, problem, and change management processes
* Previous experience in Exploris /Weblink and Basic understanding of retail operational procedures preferred
* Ability to troubleshoot IT issues as well as hardware issues for the equipment in the stores Understanding of accounts receivable and inventory management preferred but not required
* Ability to integrate with a team, yet work independently to resolve technical problems
* Experience handling multiple assignments and using prioritization skills in high\-demand situations
* Ability to communicate effectively with business users, technical staff and team members to reach solutions collaboratively, including the ability to present information and respond to questions from developers, engineers and customers
* Ability to respond to off\-hour emergencies and perform evening, weekend, and holiday work as necessary
* Ability to work on weekends one weekend a month as well as on call during the evenings every other month.

 **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**


1\-3 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience

 **CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**


ITIL certifications preferred

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. **About Us:**


Sonepar Canada is an independent family\-owned company with global market leadership in the business\-to\-business distribution of electrical, industrial and safety products and related solutions. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 100\+ locations with coverage in 9 provinces.


We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately\-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees.


To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com


***What’s In It For You?***


* You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
* You will be working for the world's \#1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
* A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
* We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
* An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.

**Position Scope:**


Sonepar IT Help Desk associates provide quality IT support via phone, email, virtual meeting, and after\-hours mobile phone. The position is 80% in the office from Monday to Friday with 1 day of working from except for 1 week per month at 100% working from the office. The service includes but is not limited to: taking initial requests by phone or email, troubleshooting, and managing hardware, software, internal ERP/WMS, or relatively simple network issues. All help desk associates need excellent problem\-solving, communication and interpersonal skills, as well as patience, a friendly attitude and the ability to work in a team environment. In addition, the help desk associate must have a solid technical understanding of the technology, including the various supported hardware, software, and network systems.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* General Support and Tasks: Sonepar IT Helpdesk Agent is responsible for providing software/technical support and assistance. They interact with customers over the phone or in person to resolve computer issues related to software and hardware issues.
* Troubleshoot customer issues: IT help desk agents also resolve issues that customers encounter on technical solutions used by the company that require guidance. They provide reliable and quality customer service to the caller associate.
* Ticket documentation: The IT help desk must thoroughly document the real\-time actions taken to execute service/incident related tickets with a high level of detail and clarity.
* Documentation: The IT Help Desk Agent must thoroughly document/update existing procedures related to the support area covered by the Sonepar Help Desk team.
* After Hours Support: Sonepar Support operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a week. After\-hours support is provided by a help desk agent on a rotational basis, approximately every six weeks. The after\-hours support assignment is weekly, from Monday evenings at 6:00 p.m. EST to Monday mornings at 6:30 a.m. EST. Support outside office hours is carried out remotely (from home), the necessary equipment is provided (laptop, cellular, headset). One bonus is offered per week of assistance outside office hours.

**Requirements:**


* 1\-3\+ years of experience in information technology with service and support computer hardware and software.
* Experience in customer service (phone/email support and communication).
* Bilingual, spoken and written (French/English).
* Experience in IT support.
* Knowledge of the Windows 11 environment.
* Knowledge of the Office 365 suite, teams, Acrobat Reader etc.
* Knowledge of IOS, Android, MacOS devices.
* Basic Active Directory Knowledge.
* Knowledge / experience with the use of the ticketing system, Service\-Now is a plus.
* Knowledge/experience with SX ERP and TWL WMS is a plus.
* May be available for office shifts from 6:30am to 3:30pm and 9:00am to 6:00pm. (Rotation)
* Ready to make a rotation support outside of working hours.

**Benefits \& Perks**


* We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits, including:
* Flexible benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account \& RRSP matching.
* Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
* Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soneparcanada/


Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id\=100057133913041


Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/SoneparCanada

Exigences du poste

**RESPONSABILITÉS CLÉS**


Soutien technique et dépannage

* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes matériels, dont sur les ordinateurs de bureau, les ordinateurs portables, les imprimantes et les périphériques
* Dépanner les problèmes logiciels dans l’environnement Windows, y compris les problèmes au niveau du système d’exploitation, les erreurs d’application et les configurations
* Aider en cas de problèmes de connectivité réseau (Wi\-Fi, VPN, LAN)
* Effectuer des tâches de base sur Active Directory : réinitialisation de mots de passe, déblocage de comptes, création de comptes utilisateurs
* Apporter son aide lors des processus d’accueil et de départ, y compris la mise en service et la mise hors service de l’équipement

**Ticket et documentation**

* Enregistrer, suivre et gérer toutes les demandes d'assistance et tous les incidents dans le système de gestion des tickets (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management ou équivalent)
* Documenter avec précision les étapes de dépannage, les solutions apportées et les problèmes récurrents
* Transmettre les problèmes non résolus ou complexes au soutien de niveau 2/niveau 3 en joignant une documentation complète
* Contribuer à l'enrichissement et à la mise à jour de la base de connaissances interne

**Service à la clientèle et communication**

* Apporter une assistance courtoise, claire et professionnelle aux utilisateurs finaux, que ce soit en personne, par téléphone ou courriel ou à l’aide d’outils de soutien à distance
* Définir et gérer les attentes des utilisateurs concernant les délais de résolution
* Assurer le suivi des tickets en cours afin de garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs et leur clôture dans les délais opportuns
* Être un interlocuteur calme et fiable en cas de perturbations techniques

**EXIGENCES**

**Formation et expérience**

* Diplôme du secondaire ou diplôme de formation général requis ; baccalauréat en ti, EN informatique ou dans un domaine connexe (nous faisons preuve de souplesse à ce sujet : la personne peut également posséder des certifications informatiques et son expérience sera prise en compte).
* Un ou deux ans d'expérience dans un service d'aide, de soutien informatique ou technique
* Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pratique sera prise en considération

**Habiletés techniques**

* Maîtrise du dépannage dans les environnements Windows 10/11 ; une expérience avec macOS serait un atout
* Expérience pratique des plateformes de gestion des tickets (ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk ou l’équivalent)
* Bonne connaissance de Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Connaissances de base des concepts réseau : DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN
* Expérience avec les outils d’aide à distance (p. ex., TeamViewer, AnyDesk, Remote Desktop)

**Compétences relationnelles**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite
* Capacité à expliquer clairement des concepts techniques à des néophytes
* Excellente gestion du temps et capacité à hiérarchiser plusieurs tickets en cours
* Patient, empathique et professionnel, même sous pression
* Motivation personnelle et envie d'apprendre et d'évoluer dans le domaine des TI

**Souhaitable / représente un plus**

* Certification CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+ ou ITIL Foundation
* Bilingue (français et anglais) un avantage pour un poste à Montréal
* Expérience dans un environnement de TI corporatif ou d’entreprise

**Notre offre**

* Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où les meilleures personnes souhaitent travailler, où elles peuvent transformer leur passion en carrière et réaliser pleinement leur potentiel.
* Développement individuel, formation en cours d’emploi et programmes conçus pour soutenir la progression de carrière.

* Assurance santé et dentaire entièrement payée par l’employeur (à l’exception de l’ILD).
* Régime de retraite à cotisation déterminée avec contribution de l’employeur équivalente à 100 % jusqu’à 6 %.
* Programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille (PAEF).
* Trois semaines de vacances dès l’entrée en poste.
* Horaire de travail flexible.
* Subvention pour le gym et le mieux‑être.
* Remboursement des frais de scolarité.
* Bonification du congé de maternité et de paternité.
