We are a communicative and collaborative team who work together towards our shared goals. FlexNetworks puts People First. We do this by fostering an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive!




The Tier 1 Network Operations Centre (NOC) Technician is responsible for the aggregation of trouble tickets across the disparate ticketing systems and outsourced, third\-party NOC entities that are engaged for FlexNetworks’ Business, Residential, and MDU lines of business. This role provides daily operational oversight to perform trouble ticket triage and resolution, ticket escalation, timely customer and internal communications, while ensuring strict adherence to SLA objectives.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **NOC Governance \& Quality Oversight**

  

* Perform triage between Network, Field Operations, and Customer Experience.
* Conduct reviews of all tickets handled to verify runbook compliance, SLA adherence, escalation completion, and communication quality.
* Monitor open tickets throughout the day for overdue updates, escalation needs, and documentation of next steps.
* Define and communicate areas where the NOCs can improve upon on ticket quality, classification accuracy, and communication standards.
* Ensure ticket queues maintain clarity, accuracy, and completeness of customer and technical information.

 **Ticket Ownership \& Assignment Integrity**

  

* Review and ensure assignment of all unassigned or misrouted tickets across all customer segments (Business, Residential, MDU).
* Validate that each ticket has a clear owner, correct severity category, and documented next action.
* Coordinate with the and Call Centre to ensure they have the information, context, and guidance needed to independently assess whether an issue is network\-related or requires field operations.
* Oversee ticket flow for all customer segments, ensuring proper escalation and handling without unnecessary handoffs.

 **SLA, Escalation \& Communication Discipline**

  

* Monitor SLA objectives for updates and restoration across Business and Residential services, including MDU.
* Intervene when SLA breaches or communication gaps occur, ensuring to escalate issues appropriately.
* Adhere to escalation time scales as set out within the FlexNetworks Customer Support and Escalation Policy
* Ensure customers receive timely, accurate updates directly from NOC without requiring Field Ops or Network teams to manage communication loops.
* Escalate unresolved SLA or coordination issues
* Review, draft, and improve Customer\-Facing communication standards to ensure they reflect operational realities and customer expectations.

 **Service Assurance \& Incident Management**

  

* Lead post\-incident reviews and create clear, customer\-ready RFO (Reason for Outage) documents.
* Analyze trends in service incidents; identify process or network improvements and escalate recommendations to appropriate teams.
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, and service assurance processes to ensure alignment across NOC, Call Centre, Network, and Field Operations teams.

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

  

* Work closely with Network, Field Operations, Customer Experience, and external NOC partners to ensure clarity of roles and escalation pathways.
* Serve as the operational point of contact for ticket\-quality questions and process improvements.
* Ensure internal process alignment, perform runbook updates, and Network/Field Ops coordination.
* Streamline workflows to improve reliability and customer satisfaction outcomes.

 **Key Traits, Qualifications \& Experience**

  

* Fundamental knowledge of networking; CCNA or similar certification is an asset.
* Experience in NOC or ISP Call\-Centre or support roles.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage ticket flows and ensure process adherence.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence teams without direct reporting authority.

 **Work Conditions**

  

* Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM, with the expectation of morning ticket reviews covering overnight activity and daytime oversight of escalations.
* Not part of a regular 24/7 technical on\-call rotation. After\-hours ticket management is handled by NOC and Call Centre teams operating to established runbooks; this role audits compliance upon return.
* Expected to monitor critical issues during business hours and intervene as needed.

new_jobs.title: Junior Scale Technician
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Advatek Systems is a Maritime\-based systems integrator with a primary focus on Weigh Scale technology and Automatic Identification and Data Capture (AIDC) systems. Since 1987, Advatek Systems has been based out of Moncton, NB while supporting a customer base across the Maritime provinces. We provide the right mix of equipment, software, technical services, and the expertise to craft a tailored solution to fulfill industry\-specific business requirements. Advatek has been a key partner to many of Atlantic Canada’s industry leaders in manufacturing, food production, lumber, aqua\-farming, municipal and provincial governments as well as healthcare.

We are currently seeking a **Junior Scale Technician** to join our team out of our Dieppe, NB office. This is an entry\-level role designed for someone with an electronics, electrical, or mechanical trade background who is ready to learn the specialized world of weigh scale technology. Working alongside experienced technicians, you will learn to install, service, troubleshoot, and calibrate weighing equipment used across the Maritimes. Through a structured 12\-week onboarding program you will work toward your first Measurement Canada accreditation, then continue building your skills and earning additional accreditations (with pay increases tied to each) over your first one to three years. **This is a permanent, full\-time position reporting to the Operations Manager.**

**Duties and Responsibilities** 

* Complete a structured 12\-week onboarding program covering safety, scale components and terminology, calibration, and legal\-for\-trade requirements
* Assemble, install, set up, and calibrate bench and floor scales in the shop and at customer sites, initially under the guidance and sign\-off of a senior technician
* Service, troubleshoot, and repair weighing equipment (load cells, indicators, junction boxes, and associated wiring), diagnosing both electrical and mechanical faults
* Prepare scales for Measurement Canada inspection and accurately complete calibration certificates, test weight correlation forms, and product test sheets
* Achieve Measurement Canada accreditation for bench and floor scales (MC 3\-10\) within the first three months
* Shadow and assist senior technicians on truck scale, industrial, and systems service calls and installation projects
* Progress to solo service calls (calibration checks, diagnostics, and routine maintenance) as skills and accreditations are signed off
* Install and support label printers and related data capture systems
* Communicate with customers in a professional manner about the work performed and system functions
* Complete all daily, weekly, and monthly paperwork, service reports, and documentation as required
* Understand, adhere to, and promote environmental health \& safety practices
* Keep company vehicle, tools, and equipment organized and well maintained
* All other duties as assigned by management

**Training and Career Progression**

* **Months 1–3 (Probation):** safety and forklift training, bench and floor scale calibration, legal\-for\-trade process, field shadowing
* **First accreditation:** MC 3\-10 exam and practical, then rostered for legal\-for\-trade work
* **Years 1–3:** self\-paced advancement through additional Measurement Canada accreditations as job opportunities allow, including:
* Retail and computing scales (counter, POS, prepack)
* Industrial systems (hopper, crane, and overhead rail)
* On\-board forklift weighing
* Truck scales (attended and unattended) and railway scales
* Mentorship throughout, and each accreditation tier earns a **permanent hourly pay increase**

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Diploma, certificate, or trade background in electronics, electrical, instrumentation, industrial mechanics (millwright), or a related technical field
* Trade work experience is an asset; recent graduates are encouraged to apply
* Working knowledge of basic electrical and electronic principles, including use of a multimeter and reading wiring diagrams
* Mechanical aptitude, strong manual dexterity, and comfort with hand and power tools
* Knowledge of low voltage industrial control systems considered an asset
* Outgoing, professional, and friendly personality with the ability to liaise with customers
* Organized, dependable, and computer\-literate, with a genuine willingness to learn
* Bilingual in French and English considered an asset but not required
* Weigh scale experience is not required; familiarity with these manufacturers is an asset: Mettler Toledo, Rice Lake, Weigh\-tronix

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Class 5 driver’s license and a clean driving record
* Willingness to obtain a Class 3 driver’s license as part of your career progression
* Achieve Measurement Canada MC 3\-10 accreditation within the 12\-week probationary period
* Comfortable with physical work, including lifting, bending, and working outdoors in all seasons
* Willingness to travel throughout the Maritimes, including occasional overnight stays
* Ability to pass a criminal record check and carry a government security clearance

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive starting wage with pay increases tied to each accreditation you earn
* Paid, hands\-on training and a clear one\-to\-three\-year certification path
* Company\-provided laptop and cell phone
* 50% employer paid comprehensive group benefits (health, dental, vision, insurance)
* Employee \& Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
* Paid travel and accommodation, including meal allowances as required
* Group Savings Plan (RRSP) with Company Matching (DPSP)

Pay: $18\.00\-$24\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 44\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Work Location: In person

Network Field Technician

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| British Columbia**  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Setting:** On\-site / Field\-based  
**Location:** Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.  
**Travel:** Regular travel between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.; occasional travel to other areas of Ontario may be required.

About Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. is a growing Managed Field Services Provider (MFSP) supporting MSPs, technology companies, enterprise IT teams, and multi\-location organizations.

We provide reliable onsite IT and infrastructure execution, acting as the field\-service execution layer between remote IT operations and physical customer locations.

Our services include:

* On\-site IT and technical support
* Network and connectivity installations
* Infrastructure deployments and technology rollouts
* Hardware and workstation deployments
* Structured cabling and physical network infrastructure
* Security and compliance\-related installations

Our work is performed using defined work orders, professional field procedures, structured documentation, and clear communication with remote IT teams and project managers.

As Viverlink expands its regional presence in the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC., we are building a professional field\-service network and are looking for technicians who can grow with the organization and take on increasingly complex assignments.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Network Field Technician** who is comfortable working independently at customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC. and can represent Viverlink professionally in the field.

This is a hands\-on role involving network equipment installation, troubleshooting, structured cabling, hardware deployment, and onsite technical support.

You will frequently work from detailed work orders and coordinate with remote engineers, MSP teams, project managers, and customer representatives.

The right candidate does not need to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting instincts, professional communication, and the ability to learn and grow.

Key ResponsibilitiesNetwork \& Infrastructure

* Install, replace, configure, and test network equipment such as switches, routers, wireless access points, and related hardware.
* Perform basic network connectivity troubleshooting using TCP/IP concepts and common diagnostic methods.
* Identify and troubleshoot physical network and infrastructure issues.
* Perform structured cabling activities, including cable routing, termination, labeling, patching, and basic testing.
* Install and organize network equipment in racks, cabinets, and customer environments.
* Assist with network upgrades, technology rollouts, hardware refreshes, and multi\-site deployments.
* Perform hardware replacement and equipment installation according to approved work instructions.

Field Service Execution

* Review work orders and site requirements before arriving onsite.
* Arrive prepared with the required tools, information, and equipment.
* Follow client\-specific instructions, technical documentation, site procedures, and safety requirements.
* Work independently while maintaining communication with remote technical teams.
* Escalate issues when they exceed the assigned scope or technical authority.
* Avoid making unauthorized changes to customer environments.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate work\-order and ticket information.
* Document work performed, findings, configuration changes, serial numbers, and relevant observations.
* Capture required photographs and other completion evidence.
* Clearly communicate issues, blockers, and outstanding work.
* Complete professional field\-service reports following Viverlink and client requirements.

Customer Interaction

* Represent Viverlink professionally at customer locations.
* Communicate clearly with site contacts and customer personnel.
* Manage expectations and provide accurate status updates.
* Maintain a professional presence in offices, retail locations, technical facilities, and other customer environments.
* Protect customer information and follow applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

Required Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate practical ability in several of the following areas:

Networking

* Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking.
* Familiarity with switches, routers, wireless access points, and network cabling.
* Ability to perform basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand IP addressing, Ethernet, VLAN concepts, and common network terminology.

Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure

* Experience with structured cabling.
* Ability to terminate, label, organize, and test network cables.
* Familiarity with patch panels, racks, cable management, and physical network infrastructure.
* Ability to use basic field testing and hand tools.

Troubleshooting

* Ability to systematically identify the cause of technical problems.
* Comfortable troubleshooting connectivity, hardware, cabling, and physical infrastructure issues.
* Able to distinguish between issues that can be resolved onsite and those requiring escalation.

Field Service

* Comfortable working independently at customer sites.
* Able to follow work orders and technical instructions accurately.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Reliable and punctual.
* Comfortable travelling between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.

Communication

* Professional verbal and written communication.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical personnel.
* Able to provide concise and accurate field updates.

Assets / Preferred Qualifications

The following are considered assets but are **not mandatory**:

* CompTIA Network\+

new_jobs.title: Analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes
new_jobs.description:
**Lieu**
--------



Ottawa (Ontario)


**Rémunération prévue**
-----------------------



50 000 $ – 65 000 $


**Supérieur immédiat**
----------------------



Directeur, technologies de l’information et sécurité informatique


**Résumé**
----------



Le Parti libéral du Canada (PLC) est à la recherche d’un analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes pour travailler à la permanence nationale du parti à Ottawa. Il s’agit d’une occasion de se joindre à une équipe d’employés dévoués qui appuient Mark Carney et l’équipe libérale pour continuer de bâtir un Canada fort.



L’analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes est chargé de fournir un soutien technique aux employés et aux bénévoles partout au pays tout en contribuant à assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et l’efficacité de l’infrastructure de TI du parti.



Le candidat idéal est soucieux du service client, à l’écoute des autres et compétent sur le plan technique. Il s’épanouit dans un milieu collaboratif au rythme soutenu.


**Avantages offerts**
---------------------


* Couverture d’assurance complète
* Programmes de bien\-être
* Programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille
* Régime de retraite à cotisations déterminées
* Horaire de travail flexible
* Emplacement de choix au centre\-ville, à proximité des commerces et des transports en commun
* Adhésion sans frais à un centre de conditionnement physique et accès à des douches
* Casiers pour vélos

**Qualités recherchées**
------------------------


* Communication
* Capacité à résoudre des problèmes
* Bonne gestion du temps
* Responsabilisation
* Souci du détail
* Professionnalisme

**Responsabilités**
-------------------


* Fournir un soutien en TI de premier niveau aux employés qui travaillent partout au pays.
* Faciliter l’intégration et le départ des employés et des intervenants, notamment en termes de création de comptes, de mise en place de l’équipement et de gestion des accès.
* Déployer et maintenir les mises à jour du système d’exploitation et des applications pour veiller à ce que les systèmes demeurent sécurisés et bénéficient d’un soutien technique.
* Surveiller et maintenir l’infrastructure et les services d’infonuagique.
* Participer aux activités liées à la cybersécurité, notamment aux niveaux de la gestion des vulnérabilités, du programme de sensibilisation à la sécurité et de l’application des pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité.
* Créer et tenir à jour de la documentation sur les processus et les systèmes.
* Maintenir un inventaire exact des ressources de TI du PLC.
* Veiller à ce que les plans de reprise après sinistre informatique soient à jour et exécutables grâce à des tests réguliers et à une documentation adéquate.
* Surveiller les orientations et les pratiques exemplaires du secteur, ainsi que les technologies émergentes, pour recommander les améliorations continues à apporter à l’infrastructure de TI du PLC.
* Exécuter d’autres tâches, au besoin.

**Critères d’embauche**
-----------------------


* Minimum de deux années d’expérience dans le domaine du soutien technique dans un milieu de prestation de services au rythme soutenu et capacité éprouvée à résoudre un vaste éventail de problèmes techniques.
* Excellentes aptitudes en service à la clientèle, en communication et en résolution de problèmes, et capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques à des utilisateurs non initiés.
* Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à prioriser les tâches et à gérer des demandes multiples de manière efficace.
* Connaissance pratique de Microsoft Windows, de Microsoft 365 et de l’infonuagique hybride (comme Azure et AWS).
* Connaissance des fondements de la réseautique, des technologies d’accès à distance, des RPV, de la gestion de l’identité et de l’accès, de la gestion des terminaux, ainsi que de la sauvegarde et de la restauration des données.
* Connaissance pratique du langage SQL, notamment pour exécuter des requêtes de base et effectuer le dépannage des intégrations qui s’appuient sur des bases de données SQL.
* Des connaissances de base en rédaction de scripts ou en automatisation (PowerShell, par exemple) sont considérées comme un atout.
* Compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en cybersécurité, comme la gestion des correctifs, la gestion des vulnérabilités et les principes de sécurité infonuagique.
* Un baccalauréat ou un diplôme collégial dans un domaine technologique est un atout.
* Les certifications techniques comme AWS cloud Practitioner, Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Security\+ constituent des atouts.
* Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) constitue un atout.

**Postulez**
------------



Le PLC défend l’équité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous encourageons fortement les candidatures des groupes visés par l’équité en emploi, notamment les femmes, les Autochtones, les personnes racisées, les personnes 2ELGBTQI\+ et les personnes vivant avec un handicap. Si vous vous considérez comme membre d’un groupe visé par l’équité en emploi, vous pouvez l’indiquer dans votre formulaire de candidature.



Cette offre d’emploi concerne un poste vacant existant. Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt envers ce poste, mais nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les personnes retenues pour un entretien. Le Parti libéral du Canada n’utilise pas l’intelligence artificielle pour trier, évaluer ou sélectionner des candidats.



Le PLC souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et examinera toute demande d’accommodement s’appuyant sur une contre\-indication médicale, la religion ou tout autre motif de discrimination illicite en vertu des lois en vigueur en matière de droits de la personne.



Le PLC invite toutes les personnes qualifiées à poser leur candidature. Le PLC a un excellent bilan relatif au soutien aux personnes handicapées. Veuillez envoyer un courriel au service des ressources humaines (hr\-rh@liberal.ca) si, pendant le processus de soumission de candidature, vous avez besoin d’un accommodement particulier ou souhaite
